papers.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
papers.abstract: Abstract Jeveration repurposes a frozen vision-language model to generate coherent images and perform image-to-image and dense prediction tasks in a single forward pass with fast 512x512 generation.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.

ru.title: Картинка за один проход: быстрая и согласованная генерация изображений
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают Jeveration — метод, который адаптирует замороженную vision-language модель для генерации изображений за один проход вперёд (single forward pass). Ключевая сложность в том, что параллельные предсказания должны согласованно складываться в целое изображение, поэтому все позиции обусловливаются общим случайным состоянием, а распределение над дискретными image codes обучается для направления генерации. Одна и та же архитектура и один checkpoint также решают задачи image-to-image и dense prediction. Модель генерирует изображение 512x512 за 78 мс, что до 122 раз быстрее существующих unified моделей при сопоставимом качестве.

en.title: One Pass, Three Vision Tasks
en.desc: Jeveration uses a frozen vision-language model to generate images and perform other visual tasks in one forward pass. It shares a random state across image positions to help parallel predictions form a coherent image, and learns distributions over discrete image codes to make the model use that state. The same architecture supports text-to-image generation, image-to-image generation, and dense prediction. It generates 512×512 images in 78 milliseconds, up to 122 times faster than existing unified models, while achieving competitive quality and prediction performance.

zh.title: 一次前向传播，快速生成连贯图像并统一视觉任务
zh.desc: Jeveration 将冻结的视觉语言模型用于图像生成，在一次前向传播中并行预测图像内容。为使并行预测形成整体连贯的图像，模型让所有位置共享随机状态，并先学习离散图像编码的分布，以引导生成过程。该架构还统一支持文生图、图像到图像生成和密集预测，三种任务都可由同一个模型检查点完成。实验显示，它能在 78 毫秒内生成 512×512 图像，速度最高可比现有统一模型快 122 倍，同时保持有竞争力的图像质量和密集预测性能。

papers.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
papers.abstract: Abstract Agent evolution is often bottlenecked by noisy evaluations that cannot reliably identify better candidate artifacts or rank methods, so progress requires making true improvements detectable and accumulable.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.

ru.title: Агенты застревают не из-за слабых идей, а из-за шумных оценок: улучшения нужно уметь надёжно отличать
ru.desc: Авторы утверждают, что эволюция LLM-агентов упирается не в умение генерировать улучшения, а в шумные оценки, которые не позволяют надёжно отличить хорошие артефакты от плохих. Гипотеза разрешения проверяется на семи методах и шести моделях (более 10 млн вызовов LLM) на двух уровнях. На уровне кандидатов выбор артефактов не лучше случайного, и ошибки накапливаются от раунда к раунду. На уровне методов различия в пару процентов меньше разброса между повторными запусками одного метода, поэтому опубликованные рейтинги часто основаны на удаче. Вывод: нужно делать улучшения обнаруживаемыми и накапливаемыми, а не только придумывать новые системы генерации.

en.title: Make Improvements Visible Before Trying to Evolve Agents
en.desc: The paper proposes the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls when noisy evaluations cannot reliably recognize genuine improvements. Across seven evolution methods and six models, the authors find that useful candidate artifacts exist, but selection often cannot distinguish them from harmful ones and may be no better than random. They also show that differences between methods are often smaller than the variation between independent runs of the same method, making rankings unreliable. The findings suggest that self-improving agents need more reliable evaluation so real gains can be identified and accumulated over time.

zh.title: 让真实改进看得见，智能体进化才能走得远
zh.desc: 智能体进化通常通过生成新的候选产物（如提示词、技能和记忆），再保留评分更高的产物来实现。本文提出“分辨率假说”：进化停滞的关键原因，可能不是方法无法提出更好的产物，而是评估噪声太大，难以识别真正的改进。研究在七种进化方法和六个模型上发现，候选产物的筛选表现不比随机选择更可靠，而不同方法之间的分数差距也常小于同一方法不同运行之间的波动。作者因此主张，应优先提升评估的可靠性，让真实改进能够被发现并逐步累积。

papers.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
papers.abstract: Abstract  Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

ru.title: Видео-ИИ, который наблюдает, спрашивает и действует вовремя
ru.desc: В статье представлена модель ALIVE, интерактивная потоковая видео-LLM, которая не только непрерывно наблюдает за происходящим, но и проактивно мониторит видео, координирует задачи в потоке и запрашивает обратную связь у пользователя. Обучение проходит в два этапа: сначала контрастивный supervised fine-tuning на датасете ALIVE-SFT-288K учит модель, когда и как отвечать, затем reinforcement learning с методом Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) на датасете ALIVE-RL-3K уточняет решения, ответы и паузы в многоходовом диалоге. Авторы также предлагают бенчмарк FSI-Bench для оценки запроса обратной связи и последующего выполнения задачи. По результатам экспериментов ALIVE показывает лучшие общие результаты на четырёх публичных бенчмарках и на FSI-Bench.

en.title: ALIVE: A video model that knows when to act, ask, or stay silent
en.desc: ALIVE is a streaming video language model that monitors ongoing video, coordinates tasks, and asks for feedback when needed. It is trained in two stages: supervised fine-tuning teaches it when and how to respond, and reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment improves its choices across multi-turn interactions. The training datasets are ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K, and the new FSI-Bench measures feedback seeking and task completion. ALIVE achieves the top overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench.

zh.title: 让视频模型持续理解、主动协作，并懂得何时开口
zh.desc: 现有流式视频大语言模型虽然能持续观察视频，却常把用户请求当作彼此独立的任务处理。本文提出 ALIVE，使模型能够主动监测、协调连续任务，并通过询问用户反馈来改进后续行动。研究构建了两个训练数据集：先用对比式监督微调训练模型判断何时以及如何回应，再用结合轨迹级与局部优势的行为对齐信用分配方法进行强化学习。作者还提出 FSI-Bench 评估模型获取反馈及完成后续任务的能力；ALIVE 在四个公开基准和该测试集上均取得最高综合成绩。

papers.title: PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling
papers.abstract: Abstract  High-resolution weather prediction is important for resolving local atmospheric patterns missed by coarse global forecasts. Large pretrained weather backbones have improved global forecasting, but adapting them to produce future high-resolution fields from recent coarse states remains challenging and costly. We formulate this setting as Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling (PSWD), a task that jointly refines spatial and temporal resolution while predicting future high-resolution trajectories. To this end, we propose a framework that decomposes prediction into spatial and temporal stages using a shared pretrained backbone, fixed numerical scaffolds, and lightweight residual heads. For backbone adaptation, we introduce PROLA (PRincipal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation), which allocates a fixed low-rank budget between pretrained weights' principal directions and their orthogonal complement. PROLA further rescales rank-1 optimizer updates using gradient signals, improving adaptation without increasing trainable rank. Experiments in the PSWD setting show that PROLA outperforms representative low-rank adaptation baselines. Further experiments across diverse datasets and tasks support the broader applicability of PROLA, showing that its benefits extend beyond the primary weather downscaling setting.
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

ru.title: Точный прогноз погоды высокого разрешения с эффективной адаптацией моделей через PROLA
ru.desc: В статье рассматривается задача предиктивного пространственно-временного даунскейлинга погоды (PSWD), в которой грубые прогнозы превращаются в будущие поля высокого разрешения. Авторы предлагают разделять предсказание на пространственный и временной этапы с использованием общего предобученного backbone, фиксированных численных каркасов и легковесных residual heads. Для адаптации backbone вводится метод PROLA, который распределяет фиксированный бюджет low-rank адаптации между главными направлениями весов и их ортогональным дополнением. PROLA также масштабирует rank-1 обновления оптимизатора с помощью градиентных сигналов и показывает преимущество над базовыми LoRA-подходами, в том числе на других задачах.

en.title: Sharper Weather Forecasts with Smarter Low-Rank Adaptation
en.desc: The paper defines Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling (PSWD), which predicts future weather while increasing both spatial and temporal resolution. Its framework uses a shared pretrained weather model, fixed numerical scaffolds, and lightweight heads to handle spatial refinement and temporal prediction in separate stages. It also introduces PROLA, a low-rank adaptation method that divides its parameter budget between the pretrained weights’ principal directions and their orthogonal complement, then adjusts rank-one updates using gradient signals. Experiments show that PROLA outperforms other low-rank adaptation methods for weather downscaling, with benefits also seen on other datasets and tasks.

zh.title: 用主方向与正交补空间，高效适配天气预测模型
zh.desc: 论文提出预测式时空天气降尺度（PSWD）任务：根据近期的低分辨率天气状态，预测未来高分辨率天气变化。该方法将预测拆为空间和时间两个阶段，并结合共享的预训练骨干网络、固定数值支架和轻量级残差头。为适配骨干网络，作者提出 PROLA，在固定的低秩预算下，将可训练方向分配到预训练权重的主方向及其正交补空间，并根据梯度信号调整秩一优化更新。实验表明，PROLA 优于多种低秩适配基线，且在其他数据集和任务上也表现出广泛适用性。

papers.title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
papers.abstract: Abstract  Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection. With Game2Player, we build 568 verified web games with 3,436 tasks, collect 15.7K trajectories (307 hours of gameplay), and hold out 50 games as the benchmark PlayerBench. To evaluate the collected experience as training data, we train VLM agents with progress-weighted SFT, assigning greater weight to steps that advance task progress. Game2Player-9B improves progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on PlayerBench and from 30.0% to 53.1% on the external GameWorld benchmark. More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.

ru.title: Масштабируем игровой опыт агентов: строим, проверяем и учимся на играх
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Game2Player — фреймворк, в котором агенты совместно создают игровые среды и игроков для сбора разнообразного и проверяемого игрового опыта. Агент-Builder адаптирует веб-игры, открывает их внутреннее состояние и задаёт задачи с метриками прогресса, а Coding Player и VLM Player выполняют эти задачи и сообщают о проблемах для исправления. Так получен набор из 568 игр, 3436 задач и 15,7 тысяч траекторий, а 50 игр вынесены в бенчмарк PlayerBench. Обучение VLM-агентов с progress-weighted SFT, где шаги, продвигающие прогресс, получают больший вес, повышает результат с 14,3% до 31,2% на PlayerBench и с 30,0% до 53,1% на GameWorld.

en.title: Build, verify, and learn from game worlds at scale
en.desc: Game2Player creates a scalable way to gather gameplay data by adapting existing web games into environments with exposed internal states and clearly defined tasks. Coding and vision-language model (VLM) players try each task, while their feedback helps the Builder agent repair and verify the games. The framework produces 568 games and 15.7K gameplay trajectories, which are used to train VLM agents with supervised fine-tuning that gives more weight to actions that advance task progress. The resulting Game2Player-9B agent makes substantially more progress on both the PlayerBench test set and the external GameWorld benchmark.

zh.title: 让智能体边造游戏、边验证、边学会玩
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 Game2Player，用智能体改造现有网页游戏，并在其中定义可验证的任务，从而大规模收集多样的游戏环境和游玩数据。构建智能体会公开游戏内部状态、设定进度指标与成功条件，再由编程玩家和视觉语言模型玩家尝试任务，并把遇到的问题反馈给构建智能体修复。研究团队据此建立了568款经过验证的游戏和3,436个任务，收集了15,700条游玩轨迹，并留出50款游戏作为 PlayerBench 基准。利用按任务进度加权的监督微调训练视觉语言模型后，模型在 PlayerBench 和 GameWorld 上的任务进度都有显著提升。

papers.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
papers.abstract: Abstract CurvDelta and CurvLoRA constrain LLM updates to a low-curvature preservation space, improving retention while maintaining target adaptation across reasoning, code, and unlearning tasks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics
Southern University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Учим модель новому, не забывая старое
ru.desc: В статье представлены CurvDelta и CurvLoRA — методы адаптации больших языковых моделей (LLM), которые ограничивают обновления весов низкокривизновым подпространством, где потеря сохранения почти не меняется. Для практичности используются K-FAC аппроксимация кривизны и факторизованная проекция. Методы тестируются на математическом рассуждении, генерации кода и selective unlearning (TOFU, MUSE). Результаты показывают лучший баланс между освоением целевых навыков и сохранением общих способностей модели, близкий к переобучению с нуля.

en.title: Adapt What Matters, Preserve What You Know
en.desc: The paper introduces CurvDelta, which restricts model updates to a low-curvature space where the preservation loss changes very little. It approximates this space efficiently using Kronecker-factored curvature and a factorized projection. CurvLoRA applies the same idea with low-rank updates for more efficient adaptation. Across reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning, the methods improve the balance between learning target capabilities and retaining other knowledge compared with baselines.

zh.title: 在低曲率空间适配，让新能力与旧能力兼得
zh.desc: 论文提出 CurvDelta，在模型更新的参数化中加入能力保留约束。它利用预训练模型附近的局部曲率，构造一个低曲率空间，使参数更新时保留损失基本不变，并用 K-FAC 和因子化投影高效实现。CurvLoRA 是基于相同几何约束的低秩版本，旨在降低适配成本。数学推理、代码生成和知识遗忘实验表明，这些方法能在完成目标任务的同时更好地保留原有能力，并在定向遗忘与知识保留之间取得较好平衡。

papers.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce HINT-WAM, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/.

ru.title: Учимся на собственных ошибках, глядя в будущее демонстрации
ru.desc: Авторы представляют HINT-WAM — первый on-policy self-distillation фреймворк для World Action Models в манипуляции роботами. Модель-студент генерирует действия по собственной траектории денойзинга, а модель-учитель получает дополнительно hindsight, то есть видео демонстрации из будущего, как privileged information. Учитель даёт плотный сигнал в виде условного распределения действий, без наград среды и симулятора. Дистилляция в flow-matching action expert выполняется через energy score, который сопоставляет распределения действий, а не регрессирует velocity field.

en.title: Learn from your own actions—with hindsight as the teacher
en.desc: HINT-WAM improves robot manipulation by training a world action model on the action trajectories it generates itself. For each demonstration, the model uses the future video as hindsight to provide a teacher with privileged information, producing dense action-distribution targets along the student's denoising trajectory. The student learns from these targets using an energy score, which matches action distributions rather than regressing the teacher's velocity field. This on-policy self-distillation needs neither environmental rewards nor simulator interaction, while aiming to make task execution more reliable without sacrificing pretrained abilities.

zh.title: 让模型借助示范的未来画面，从自己的行动轨迹中学会更可靠地行动
zh.desc: 世界动作模型（WAM）通过同时生成动作并预测未来视觉变化，在机器人操作中展现出良好的泛化能力和数据效率，但可靠地适应具体任务仍有困难。本文提出 HINT-WAM，一种在线自蒸馏框架：学生模型沿着自身的动作采样轨迹生成动作，教师模型则额外利用示范视频中的未来画面（即“事后信息”），为这些轨迹提供密集的动作分布监督。学生训练时只使用实际部署可获得的输入，因此不需要环境奖励或模拟器交互。为适配流匹配动作专家，方法采用能量分数这一分布级目标，使学生根据自身采样匹配教师的动作分布，而不是直接回归速度场。

papers.title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract LightTAR adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task by adding target-aware features from encoder layers via regularized partial least squares, improving multimodal tabular model performance with minimal runtime overhead.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA). This reduction prioritizes input variance but may overlook information relevant to predicting the target. We introduce LightTAR, a simple, inexpensive method that adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task. LightTAR augments the standard PCA representation with a few target-aware features extracted jointly from the final and an intermediate encoder layer using regularized partial least squares (PLS). We evaluate LightTAR with 21 tabular models, including tree ensembles, neural networks, and tabular foundation models. LightTAR improves average predictive performance for all models and, averaged across models, improves prediction on almost every MulTaBench dataset. These gains come with a small increase in total runtime relative to PCA representations. LightTAR integrates directly into existing encoding pipelines, improving tabular learners' predictive performance without modifying the encoder or the learner.

ru.title: Учитывать цель уже при снижении размерности: LightTAR улучшает мультимодальные табличные модели
ru.desc: Статья представляет LightTAR — простой и недорогой метод, который адаптирует снижение размерности под конкретную задачу предсказания. К стандартным PCA-признакам из эмбеддингов предобученных энкодеров добавляются несколько target-aware признаков, извлекаемых из последнего и промежуточного слоя с помощью регуляризованного partial least squares (PLS). Метод оценивался на 21 табличной модели, включая ансамбли деревьев, нейронные сети и tabular foundation models, и улучшил качество предсказаний почти на всех датасетах MulTaBench. При этом рост времени работы относительно PCA незначителен, а сам подход не требует изменения энкодера или обучаемой модели.

en.title: Keep PCA’s features; add the ones that predict
en.desc: Multimodal tabular models use pretrained encoders to turn text and images into features, often reducing them with principal component analysis (PCA). PCA preserves features with high input variance, which may not be the features most useful for predicting the target. LightTAR keeps the PCA features and adds a few target-aware features from final and intermediate encoder layers using regularized partial least squares (PLS). Across 21 tabular models, it improves predictive performance on nearly all tested datasets with only a small runtime increase.

zh.title: 让降维关注预测目标，让多模态表格模型预测更准
zh.desc: 多模态表格学习需要结合数值、类别等结构化特征，以及文本和图像等非结构化特征进行分类或回归。通常会先用预训练编码器提取文本和图像表示，再用主成分分析（PCA）降维；但 PCA 侧重保留输入的变化，可能丢失对预测目标有用的信息。LightTAR 在 PCA 表示之外，利用正则化偏最小二乘（PLS），从编码器的最后一层和一个中间层提取少量与目标相关的特征。实验显示，该方法提升了多种表格模型在几乎所有 MulTaBench 数据集上的平均预测表现，且只带来少量额外运行开销。

papers.title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
papers.abstract: Abstract A rule-graph-based generative world model preserves user-defined rules and world states across saving and loading while accurately realizing rule-induced visual changes on designated objects and attributes.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. The graph supports joint saving and restoration of rules and world states, while dynamic object binding grounds rule-specified entities in visual instances and uses stored states to constrain generation from their first appearance. We further introduce object attribute state replacement and counterfactual reconstruction training, enabling accurate attribute control and compatible appearance and motion changes while limiting interference with unrelated content. We develop an automated data collection and annotation pipeline using GTA-V and Habitat to construct RuleVerse, a dataset of rule-driven interactions with detailed state and event annotations, including cases where rules take effect before affected objects become visible. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRuler in preserving rule-state consistency across saving and loading and accurately realizing rule outcomes on designated objects and attributes.

ru.title: Правила игры, которые не теряются при сохранении
ru.desc: В статье представлен WorldRuler — генеративная модель мира на основе графа правил, которая сохраняет пользовательские правила и состояния мира при сохранении и загрузке. Граф правил (3D rule graph) хранит определения правил, зависимости и состояния объектов и связывает исполнение правил, генерацию видео через LLM-подобные и diffusion-модели и перцептивную обратную связь в замкнутый цикл. Динамическое связывание объектов (dynamic object binding) привязывает сущности из правил к визуальным экземплярам и ограничивает генерацию сохранёнными состояниями даже до их первого появления в кадре. Для обучения авторы вводят замену состояний атрибутов объектов и counterfactual reconstruction, а также датасет RuleVerse, собранный автоматически с помощью GTA-V и Habitat, с подробными аннотациями состояний и событий.

en.title: WorldRuler: Keep the Rules, Change the World
en.desc: The paper introduces WorldRuler, a generative world model that follows user-defined rules in interactive 3D environments. It stores rules, their dependencies, and world states in an executable 3D rule graph, allowing them to be restored consistently after saving and loading. Dynamic object binding and attribute-state replacement help the model apply rule-driven changes to the correct objects, even before they become visible, while limiting unintended changes elsewhere. The authors also create the RuleVerse dataset and report experiments showing that WorldRuler preserves rule-state consistency and generates the intended visual outcomes.

zh.title: 让自定义规则持久生效，让生成世界忠实呈现
zh.desc: 论文提出了 WorldRuler，一个能按用户自定义规则生成交互世界的生成式世界模型。它用可执行的 3D 规则图组织规则、依赖关系和物体状态，并支持保存与加载后保持这些信息一致。动态物体绑定、属性状态替换和反事实重建训练帮助模型把规则准确应用到指定物体，即使物体尚未出现在画面中，也能控制其后续外观和运动，同时减少对其他内容的影响。论文还构建了 RuleVerse 数据集；实验表明，WorldRuler 能在世界恢复后维持规则与状态的一致性，并准确呈现规则产生的视觉变化。

papers.title: Code World Model 2.0: Towards Infinite Controllable Video Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry depending on the interaction, and streaming inference must operate in a few causal steps without accumulating drift across self-generated history. We present Invoker-Render, pairing a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model under a shared conditioning interface over structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language. Trained on an aligned approximately 200-hour multi-granularity corpus, Invoker-Render honors fine geometric constraints when supplied while synthesizing plausible local motion under coarse proxies, enabling runtime selection of input detail. To bridge bidirectional creation and real-time streaming without compounding step compression and rollout drift, we introduce Progressive Forcing (ProForcing). ProForcing first trains a causal predictor and distills it into a four-step renderer using histories derived from training videos. Training then shifts to continuous self-generated rollouts. A pipelined serving stack supports efficient streaming inference. Experiments show versatile control across proxy families, granularities, and camera paths, consistent gains over recent streaming baselines, and stable 30-minute racing rollouts that preserve scene and subject appearance.

ru.title: Управляемое видео в реальном времени без накопления ошибок
ru.desc: Статья представляет Invoker-Render — систему для генерации видео, которая использует визуальные прокси (структурные наброски, геометрию, опорное изображение и текст) как управляемый интерфейс. Модель обучена на корпусе примерно из 200 часов видео и умеет учитывать как грубые, так и точные геометрические ограничения. Для потоковой генерации в реальном времени предложен метод Progressive Forcing (ProForcing), который переводит двунаправленную модель в каузальную четырёхшаговую и обучает её на собственных авторегрессионных развёртках, чтобы избежать накопления ошибок. Эксперименты показывают стабильную генерацию без дрейфа даже на 30-минутных роликах.

en.title: From Simple Proxies to Stable, Real-Time Worlds
en.desc: Invoker-Render turns structural proxies, appearance references, and language into photorealistic videos. It uses one bidirectional model for creating clips and a causal four-step model for real-time streaming, adapting to proxies ranging from coarse layouts to detailed geometry. Its Progressive Forcing method trains the streaming model first on histories from real videos, then on its own generated rollouts to reduce drift. Experiments show flexible control, improvements over recent streaming baselines, and stable appearance in racing videos lasting 30 minutes.

zh.title: 从可控代理到稳定长时流式视频生成
zh.desc: 本文提出 Invoker-Render，将双向视频生成模型与因果四步流式模型结合，并通过统一接口使用结构代理、外观参考和语言进行条件控制。它在约 200 小时的多粒度对齐数据上训练，能够依据输入代理的细节程度遵循几何约束，或在粗略代理下生成合理的局部运动。为降低步数压缩和自回归生成历史带来的误差累积，作者提出渐进式强制训练（ProForcing）：先训练因果预测器并将其蒸馏为四步渲染器，再逐步改用模型自身生成的连续历史进行训练。实验表明，该方法能适配多种代理、细节粒度和摄像机路径，优于近期流式基线，并能在长达 30 分钟的赛车视频生成中保持场景与主体外观稳定。

papers.title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
papers.abstract: Abstract StrideWorld is a benchmark that fixes references before motion to detect scene deformation and action inconsistency in interactive video world models, showing that most models deform scenes and only depth-scaled command models preserve composed routes.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across  videos generated by  open models from 140 start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to 7.3 times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.
affiliations: Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University

ru.title: Эталоны до движения: проверяем, что мировая модель не деформирует сцену и не сбивается с маршрута
ru.desc: Статья представляет StrideWorld — бенчмарк для оценки интерактивных video world models, где сгенерированная сцена должна сохранять 3D-структуру при движении камеры. В отличие от существующих метрик, эталоны фиксируются заранее по геометрии стартового вида и по stride каждого действия, что не позволяет модели «подстроить» эталон под собственное видео. Эксперименты на 140 стартовых видах показывают, что большинство открытых моделей деформируют сцену и часто останавливаются на составных маршрутах, а только модели с масштабированием команд по оценённой глубине сцены приближаются к ожидаемым позициям. Дообучение на нескольких отрендеренных клипах устраняет большую часть остановок в середине маршрута.

en.title: Fix the reference, reveal the drift
en.desc: StrideWorld is a benchmark for testing whether interactive video models keep scenes rigid and respond consistently to movement commands. Unlike earlier tests, it sets reference measurements before the camera moves, so scene warping and route errors cannot be hidden by adjusting the reference afterward. Tests on videos from open models show that nearly all models deform scenes, and many fail to reach the positions predicted by their own movement strides on multi-step routes. Models that scale commands using estimated scene depth perform better on composed routes, while fine-tuning on a small number of rendered clips reduces stalls.

zh.title: 先固定参照，再检验世界模型的空间与动作一致性
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 StrideWorld，用于评估交互式视频世界模型是否能在镜头移动时保持场景的三维结构，并让动作产生稳定效果。与依赖待测视频来调整参照的旧方法不同，StrideWorld 在运动开始前就固定参照，以减少场景变形或路线偏差被掩盖的情况。研究发现，除一个模型外，其余模型都会出现场景变形；在连续路线中，许多模型会停顿或偏离预期位置，只有两个根据估计场景深度缩放指令的模型，大多能接近目标位置。研究还表明，用少量渲染视频微调模型可以减少路线中途停顿，并公开了基准、数据和排行榜。

papers.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

ru.title: Умные данные и самоулучшение важнее размера модели
ru.desc: В статье представлено семейство мультимодальных decision-моделей Piccolo (от 0.8B до 27B параметров), которые обучаются через Agentic Data Engineering и рекурсивное самоулучшение (RSI). Исследовательские агенты анализируют поведение модели, создают обучающие данные, проводят эксперименты и используют результаты для уточнения следующих предложений, а общая память и семантические срезы связывают эти шаги. Модели Piccolo-27B, 9B и 4B занимают первые места на лидерборде Decision Index Vision Full и приватном бенчмарке в своих категориях размера. Авторы выделяют три неочевидных вывода: совместная адаптация backbone и рецепта обучения важнее новизны модели, целенаправленная курация данных позволяет моделям 4B-9B конкурировать с 27B, а снижение loss не всегда повышает точность дискретных решений.

en.title: Smarter Data and Feedback Can Beat Bigger, Newer Models
en.desc: Piccolo is a family of multimodal decision models that predict probabilities for possible answers to text and visual tasks. Research agents study model behavior, create and select training data, run experiments, and use the results to improve later models and proposals. The paper finds that matching a model backbone to its training recipe matters more than using the newest backbone, and carefully curated data can help smaller models compete with larger ones on specialized tasks. It also shows that lower training loss does not always mean better decision accuracy.

zh.title: 让模型与数据共同进化，打造更强决策能力
zh.desc: 本文提出 Piccolo 系列多模态决策模型，规模从 0.8B 到 27B，并通过智能体数据工程和递归自我改进共同迭代模型与训练数据。模型会为文本和视觉判断、智能体流程、数据工作流及互动游戏中的候选答案预测概率。研究智能体分析模型表现、构建训练数据并开展实验，再利用结果改进后续方案；语义切片与共享研究记忆则帮助各项工作相互衔接。实验发现，骨干模型与训练配方的适配、针对性数据筛选及决策准确率的直接反馈都很关键，因为更低的损失并不一定带来更好的离散决策表现。

papers.title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
papers.abstract: Abstract  Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1times less data and >120times fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.

ru.title: Качественные данные важнее сложного RL: логика и зум для визуального поиска
ru.desc: В статье представлен LogT — полностью автоматизированный движок генерации данных для SFT, который учит vision-language модели (VLM) рассуждать с изображениями и использовать внешний инструмент приближения (Zoom-in). Авторы показали, что ключевым узким местом является качество SFT-данных, а не сложность RL, и создали датасет с визуально обоснованными вопросами и логическими цепочками использования инструмента. Модели Qwen2.5-VL-7B и InternVL3.5-8B, дообученные на этих данных, превосходят state-of-the-art методы, обученные с SFT и RL, при использовании в 3.1 раза меньше данных и более чем в 120 раз меньше GPU-часов. Простой RL без специального дизайна под инструмент поверх LogT-SFT даёт прирост в 9.59 пункта, при этом модель показывает более точное и эффективное использование инструмента и логически согласованные цепочки рассуждений.

en.title: Better Visual Reasoning Starts with Better Training Data
en.desc: This paper introduces LogT, an automated system that creates supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data for vision-language models using step-by-step logical reasoning and image-based tool-use traces. The data teaches models to ask challenging visual questions and use a zoom-in tool accurately and efficiently. Fine-tuning on LogT data outperforms prior methods on seven benchmarks while using far less training data and GPU time. Adding a simple reinforcement learning (RL) stage improves results further, without requiring specialized tool-use RL designs.

zh.title: 让高质量逻辑数据驱动更聪明、更高效的图像推理
zh.desc: 这篇论文关注视觉语言模型（VLM）如何借助放大工具，搜索图像中的细节并进行逻辑推理。作者认为，能力提升的关键瓶颈不是强化学习（RL）设计不够复杂，而是监督微调（SFT）数据质量不足，因此提出自动化数据引擎 LogT，用逻辑链引导生成训练数据。LogT 构建了包含高难度视觉问题和结构化工具使用过程的数据集，用它微调模型后，在七项基准测试中取得了强劲表现，且所需数据量和 GPU 训练时间显著更少。基于 LogT-SFT 再使用简单的 RL 方法，也能超过采用复杂 RL 方案的先前方法，同时提升工具使用准确性、效率和推理逻辑性。

papers.title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract BLIP-Live unifies data, metrics, inference, and training for proactive streaming video understanding, using the PAUC-F metric and achieving state-of-the-art results on proactive streaming benchmarks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.

ru.title: Отвечать вовремя: видео-ИИ, который знает, когда молчать
ru.desc: В статье представлен BLIP-Live — фреймворк для проактивного понимания потокового видео, объединяющий данные, метрики, инференс-обвязку и обучение. Авторы собрали датасет BLIP-Live-780K с человеческой разметкой содержания и времени проактивных ответов, а также предложили метрику PAUC-F, которая сочетает своевременность ответа с точностью срабатываний (precision). Исследование показывает, что комбинация скользящих визуальных окон, онлайн-памяти взаимодействия и структурированного вывода даёт лучшие результаты для офлайн VLM. Модель BLIP-Live-Qwen достигает state-of-the-art на четырёх бенчмарках с приростом до 44% и превосходит ряд закрытых API-моделей.

en.title: Respond at the right moment—not just the earliest one
en.desc: BLIP-Live is a framework for video systems that decide when to respond while a video is still streaming. It introduces a dataset with human labels for what to say and when, and PAUC-F, a metric that rewards timely, useful responses while penalizing unnecessary ones. The framework also tests inference methods and training pipelines for vision-language models, finding that sliding video windows, interaction memory, and structured responses work well together. Its BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieves state-of-the-art results on four benchmarks, outperforming baselines by up to 44%.

zh.title: 让视频模型恰到好处地开口：及时回应，不乱发声
zh.desc: 本文提出 BLIP-Live 框架，用于让视频理解模型在串流过程中主动判断何时应该回应、何时应该保持沉默。作者构建了包含 78 万条样本的数据集，并提出 PAUC-F 指标，综合评估回应的及时性与触发准确率，避免模型过早或过度回应。研究还探索了无需修改模型的推理方法和训练流程，发现滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆与结构化输出结合时效果最佳。训练得到的 BLIP-Live-Qwen 在四项主动串流基准测试中达到最先进水平，最高比基线提升 44%，并优于多个闭源 API 模型。

papers.title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). For such software, a key testing bottleneck is reaching a deep state, one that requires a long interaction history. The cost of reaching it recurs across commits, and the GUI automation that could amortize it assumes a DOM or accessibility tree that self-rendered engines do not expose. We introduce StatePortal, an agent that synthesizes a checkpoint, an artifact that restores that state and can be versioned and replayed, from a natural-language functional test case and read-only access to the target's source code. The checkpoint is restored through a per-application hook that an onboarding agent binds or synthesizes once without hand-written hook code. Because a checkpoint can satisfy state checks while rendering incorrectly, checkpoints are scored by hybrid programmatic-state and visual evaluation: acceptance requires both a programmatic-state oracle and a visual oracle to pass. We calibrate the visual oracle against a blinded cross-VLM reference. We release DeepStateBench, 61 deep-state tasks across 10 interactive applications that span five language families and six rendering stacks, with source sizes from 874 to 7.2M lines. Across three registered models, a GUI agent seeded with synthesized checkpoints completes 10.4% of trials, compared with 0% without seeding under the same pixel action space, while StatePortal, which also delivers the target action through the hook, completes 27.5%. Over 1,361 replays of 112 checkpoints, 98.90% reproduce the original verdict with zero model calls, and the hybrid oracle detects 96.25% (77/80) of controlled visual faults invisible to programmatic-state checks alone. We open-source our code at https://github.com/pzy2000/State_Portal and website at https://stateportal.mineyosemite.chatgpt.site

ru.title: Быстрый доступ к глубоким состояниям GUI через воспроизводимые checkpoint
ru.desc: В статье представлен StatePortal — LLM-агент, который по тест-кейсу на естественном языке и доступу к исходному коду приложения синтезирует checkpoint, то есть артефакт для восстановления глубокого состояния GUI без DOM или accessibility tree. Восстановление выполняется через hook, который онбординг-агент привязывает или синтезирует один раз для каждого приложения. Качество checkpoint оценивается гибридно: программным state-оракулом и визуальным оракулом, калиброванным против слепого cross-VLM эталона. На бенчмарке DeepStateBench из 61 задачи и 10 приложений агент с синтезированными checkpoint проходит 27.5% попыток против 0% у базового GUI-агента, а 98.90% реплеев воспроизводят исходный вердикт без вызовов модели.

en.title: Restore Deep GUI States, Then Verify What Users See
en.desc: StatePortal is an agent that creates reusable checkpoints for interactive applications from a natural-language test and read-only source-code access. An onboarding agent connects each application to a hook that can restore the checkpoint without requiring developers to write hook code. Checkpoints are accepted only when both a programmatic-state oracle and a visual oracle confirm that the restored state is correct. On DeepStateBench, seeding GUI agents with checkpoints improved task completion, while StatePortal’s hook-based actions achieved higher completion and its hybrid oracle caught visual faults missed by state checks alone.

zh.title: 自动合成可重放检查点，让 GUI 测试直达深层状态
zh.desc: StatePortal 能根据自然语言功能测试和只读源代码，自动生成可版本管理、可重放的检查点，用来快速恢复交互软件中的深层状态。它通过一次性绑定或生成应用钩子来恢复状态，不要求应用提供 DOM 或无障碍树。为避免状态检查通过但画面错误，系统结合程序状态和视觉两种判定，并要求两者都通过；视觉判定还经过盲测的多模态模型参考校准。在包含 61 个任务的基准测试中，使用生成检查点的 GUI 智能体完成率为 10.4%，由 StatePortal 通过钩子执行目标操作时为 27.5%，而不使用检查点时为 0%。

papers.title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
papers.abstract: Abstract A diagnostic benchmark and two-phase reinforcement learning framework enable personalized vision-language assistants to jointly connect visual hazard evidence with personal memory for appropriate responses.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user. When the observed scene contains a physical hazard, personal context, such as allergies, medical conditions, or mobility constraints, can change what help is appropriate. Responding appropriately therefore requires recognizing the visible hazard and applying the relevant person's information. We introduce PReMind-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates this combination across diverse hazards and personal-memory conditions. It separately measures memory access, grounding, abstention, and hazard response, and assesses joint success on interdependency cases. Existing models often satisfy one requirement while failing the other, and training only for safety or personalization leaves a gap in joint success. We therefore propose PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that combines on-demand and forced-call interactions (memory always retrieved) to jointly train grounded memory use and hazard response. At 4B, PReMind raises joint success from 12.9% to 28.6% over its base on the interdependency set and improves hazard adequacy and correct abstention on the main test. Joint-success gains persist under forced-call evaluation and under a second LLM judge across three Phase II seeds; averaged over these seeds, joint success also improves on unseen hazard groups. These findings highlight the need to evaluate and train personal assistants to connect visual evidence with the relevant person's context.

ru.title: Видеть опасность и помнить о человеке: ассистент, который связывает оба
ru.desc: В статье представлен диагностический бенчмарк PReMind-Bench для персонализированных vision-language ассистентов, которые должны связывать визуальные опасности с личной информацией пользователя, например аллергиями или ограничениями мобильности. Бенчмарк раздельно измеряет доступ к памяти, grounding, воздержание от ответа и реакцию на опасность, а также совместный успех на случаях взаимозависимости. Авторы предлагают двухфазный фреймворк reinforcement learning PReMind, который сочетает режимы on-demand и forced-call для совместного обучения использованию памяти и реакции на опасность. На модели 4B совместный успех вырос с 12.9% до 28.6%, а улучшения сохраняются при альтернативном LLM judge и на неизвестных группах опасностей.

en.title: See the hazard, remember the person, give the right advice
en.desc: The paper studies vision-language assistants that must recognize hazards in images and use relevant personal information, such as allergies or mobility limits, to give suitable advice. It introduces PReMind-Bench, a benchmark that measures memory use, visual grounding, appropriate abstention, hazard response, and success when these skills must work together. It also proposes PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that trains assistants with both on-demand memory retrieval and settings where memory is always retrieved. In tests, PReMind nearly doubles joint success over its base model and improves hazard responses and appropriate abstention, including on unseen hazard groups.

zh.title: 看清危险，也记住你：让视觉助手把个人背景融入安全应答
zh.desc: 本文提出 PReMind-Bench，用于评估视觉语言助手能否结合画面中的危险迹象与用户的个人信息，给出合适建议。基准分别测量记忆调用、视觉 grounding、拒答能力和危险应对，并重点检验这些能力需要协同工作的情形。作者还提出两阶段强化学习框架 PReMind，通过按需调用和强制调用记忆来训练助手兼顾视觉依据、个人背景与安全响应。在 4B 模型上，PReMind 将关键测试中的联合成功率从 12.9% 提高到 28.6%，并改善危险应对和正确拒答表现。

papers.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. We study the opposite strategy, late entry, where new tokens skip initial passes and enter directly into the final K < T passes over a deep context cache. Once lightweight fine-tuning resolves hidden-state norm mismatch at the entry boundary, deep cached context substitutes for skipped token-local passes, allowing late entry to outperform matched early exit across model families and pass budgets. To turn this asymmetry into wall-clock speedups without stalling to build deep caches, candidate blocks verify through only the final K passes on the critical path while previously committed tokens complete passes 1 -> T alongside subsequent steps at zero extra serial calls. Projecting these finished T-pass wake states inside the existing output GEMM (Wake verification, governed by logit-margin tolerance tau in [0, inf]) unifies greedy-exact T-pass decoding (tau = 0, matching K = T block decoding within bf16 reduction order), margin-gated verification (tau > 0), and non-rollback lossy late entry (tau = inf) inside a single static CUDA graph. On Ouro-2.6B (T = 4), K = 2 Wake reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup at tau = 0 (+26% over K = 4 block decoding on GSM8K) and 6.8x at tau = inf (+16.9 points over trained early exit at matched speed). Scaling test-time recurrence across T in {8, 16, 32, 64} on Huginn-3.5B cuts K = T/4 rollbacks 21.5x with depth, driving greedy-exact (tau = 0) speedups to 6.1x (T = 32) and 8.4x (T = 64, +153% over K = 64 block) and tau = inf speedups to 10.6 to 12.5x.

ru.title: Поздний вход в глубокий контекст ускоряет рекуррентные LLM без потери качества
ru.desc: Статья предлагает стратегию «позднего входа» для циклических языковых моделей (looped LLM), при которой новые токены пропускают первые проходы и сразу попадают в последние K из T проходов над глубоким KV-кэшем контекста. После лёгкого дообучения, устраняющего рассогласование норм скрытых состояний на границе входа, такой подход превосходит классический early exit при том же бюджете проходов. Метод Wake позволяет совмещать точное greedy-декодирование (tau = 0), декодирование с проверкой по порогу логит-маржи (tau > 0) и lossy-вариант без отката (tau = inf) в одном статическом CUDA graph. Ускорение достигает 5.2x–12.5x на моделях Ouro-2.6B и Huginn-3.5B.

en.title: Skip the early passes, keep the reasoning, and decode faster
en.desc: This paper speeds up looped language models, which reuse the same layers several times to deepen reasoning. Its late-entry method lets new tokens skip early passes and use the final passes, relying on deep cached information from earlier tokens; lightweight fine-tuning helps align the hidden states. Wake verification overlaps the skipped work for committed tokens with later decoding, while checking candidate tokens using only the final passes. Experiments show substantial speedups, including exact greedy decoding, with larger gains as the number of repeated passes increases.

zh.title: 让新词元晚进入，让深层推理更快完成
zh.desc: 循环语言模型通过反复使用同一组网络层来加深推理，但每次循环都会增加生成延迟。本文提出“晚进入”方法，让新词元跳过前几轮计算，直接使用深层缓存，并通过轻量微调解决进入位置的状态差异。作者还提出 Wake 验证：新词元只在关键路径上运行最后几轮，而已提交词元则并行完成全部循环，从而减少串行等待。实验显示，该方法在保持精确解码或允许一定误差时，都能显著加速生成，且循环深度越大，收益越明显。

papers.title: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract A new benchmark and agentic workflows assess vision-language models for automatic video rough-cut, revealing current models struggle to match expert cut plans.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video cases, covering highlight detection and selection, source-video ordering, and adherence to user requirements when provided; and (2) a speech-driven setting over automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, covering filler removal, expression deduplication, and low-value content trimming. Across these settings, the benchmark contains 101 visually driven cases, including 831 raw videos with 1,476 highlight annotations. It also includes 84 speech-driven cases, each consisting of an ASR transcript with annotated cleanup spans. The evaluation compares cut plans with these annotations in both settings and additionally uses a human-aligned agentic evaluator to assess rendered-cut quality in the visual setting. To apply LVLMs to automatic rough-cut, we further propose agentic workflows that guide them to produce structured cut plans from input materials. Experiments show that current LVLMs remain limited in producing expert-aligned cut plans. Our benchmark, code, and prompts are released at https://whalesong-zrs.github.io/RoughCut-Bench-Project-Page.

ru.title: Нейросети ещё не монтируют как профессионалы: новый бенчмарк RoughCut-Bench показывает разрыв
ru.desc: В статье представлен новый бенчмарк RoughCut-Bench для оценки больших vision-language моделей (LVLM) в задаче автоматического rough-cut, то есть первичной сборки видео из сырого медиаматериала. Бенчмарк включает два режима: визуальный, где модель выбирает хайлайты, упорядочивает исходные видео и учитывает пользовательские требования, и речевой, где по ASR-транскриптам нужно удалять слова-паразиты, дубликаты и малоценные фрагменты. Авторы также предлагают агентные workflow, которые пошагово направляют LVLM к созданию структурированных план-монтажа, а качество итогового ролика оценивается агентным evaluator, согласованным с человеческими оценками. Эксперименты показывают, что современные LVLM пока плохо воспроизводят планы монтажа экспертов.

en.title: Testing Whether AI Can Make an Expert First Cut
en.desc: This paper introduces RoughCut-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models on automatic video rough-cut editing. It tests visual tasks, such as finding highlights and ordering clips, and transcript-based tasks, such as removing filler words and trimming unimportant content. The authors also propose agentic workflows that guide models to create structured cut plans, and evaluate plans against expert annotations and rendered-cut quality. Experiments show that current models still struggle to produce cut plans that match expert judgment.

zh.title: 建立粗剪评测基准，让模型剪辑能力接受专家检验
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 RoughCut-Bench，用于评估视觉语言模型自动生成视频粗剪方案的能力。基准包含视觉驱动和语音驱动两类任务，分别评测高光选择、素材排序、用户要求遵循，以及口头语删除、重复表达合并和低价值内容修剪。作者还设计了智能体工作流，引导模型根据视频或语音识别文本生成结构化、可执行的剪辑方案，并通过标注和人工对齐的评估方法衡量结果。实验表明，当前模型生成的剪辑方案仍难以达到专家水平。

papers.title: Mechanistic Critics for Sample-Efficient NPU Design-Space Exploration
papers.abstract: Abstract  NPU design-space exploration for LLM inference mainly relies on an expensive simulator that often returns only scalar feedback such as latency and power. Such feedback can rank evaluated configurations, but gives little information for deciding why a configuration is slow or which architecture parameter should be changed next. This limitation is especially severe because prefill and decode workloads can be limited by different resources, including compute throughput and HBM bandwidth. We propose CriticNPU, a sample-efficient DSE framework built around an online-calibrated mechanistic critic for NPU architecture design. The critic uses explicit hardware limits to evaluate NPU configurations: before simulation, it estimates whether a proposed configuration is likely to improve over the current best and filters weak candidates; after simulation, it aggregates operator-level runtimes into prefill/decode bottleneck summaries and predicts the effect of candidate parameter changes. We instantiate the critic with a Roofline-style model that derives compute and memory limits from architecture parameters and calibrates per-operator-type effective limits using simulator observations. And CriticNPU combines this critic with a workload extractor and an architecture planner to propose configurations. Across six LLM workloads and 16 deployment configurations per model, CriticNPU achieves best-or-tied-best latency in 74% of prefill and 87.5% of decode settings while using roughly half the simulator calls of competitive DSE baselines. We conduct extensive ablation studies and detailed analyses to validate the effectiveness of our method from multiple perspectives. Our code is available at https://github.com/bruno686/CriticNPU.

ru.title: Умный критик вместо слепого перебора: быстрее находим лучший NPU для LLM
ru.desc: Статья предлагает CriticNPU — эффективный фреймворк для проектирования архитектуры NPU под инференс LLM, где обычный симулятор дорог и выдает лишь скалярные метрики вроде задержки и мощности. Ключевая идея — механистический критик на основе Roofline-модели, который использует явные аппаратные ограничения по вычислениям и пропускной способности HBM и калибруется онлайн по наблюдениям симулятора для каждого типа операторов. Критик отфильтровывает слабые конфигурации до симуляции и предсказывает эффект изменения параметров, разделяя prefill и decode, которые упираются в разные ресурсы. В экспериментах на шести LLM-нагрузках CriticNPU показывает лучшую или равную лучшей задержку в большинстве случаев при примерно вдвое меньшем числе вызовов симулятора.

en.title: Use bottleneck insights to find better NPU designs with fewer simulations
en.desc: CriticNPU helps find efficient NPU designs for large language model (LLM) inference while reducing reliance on costly simulations. Its online-calibrated critic uses hardware limits and simulator results to identify likely bottlenecks, such as compute throughput or HBM bandwidth, and estimate how design changes may affect performance. A workload extractor and architecture planner use this guidance to choose promising configurations for simulation. Across six workloads, CriticNPU matched or achieved the best latency in most prefill and decode settings while using about half as many simulator calls as competing methods.

zh.title: 洞察性能瓶颈，让 NPU 架构探索更快更准
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了 CriticNPU，用于更高效地探索适合大语言模型推理的 NPU 架构设计。它使用在线校准的机制化评估器，根据硬件计算能力和 HBM 带宽估计配置表现，并筛除可能较差的候选方案。模拟完成后，评估器会分析算子运行时间，判断预填充（prefill）和解码（decode）阶段的瓶颈，并预测调整架构参数的影响。在六种模型工作负载和多种部署配置的实验中，CriticNPU 在大多数设置下取得最佳或并列最佳延迟，同时将模拟器调用次数减少约一半。

papers.title: Decoding Without a Decoder: Direct Pixel Prediction from Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Abstract A method that removes the decoder from latent diffusion models by adding a final-step prediction head to a finetuned diffusion transformer, reducing inference cost and improving pixel quality in image and video generation.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Latent diffusion models rely on a decoder to map denoised latents to pixels, adding complexity and inference cost. We introduce Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD), which lets a finetuned diffusion transformer produce final pixels directly through a linear head. Unlike previous methods, where the denoising output leads to final pixels, DWD separates the two roles: the original denoising head continues to drive sampling, then the new DWD head predicts the pixels at the final step. We extend pretrained latent models with DWD efficiently by finetuning only the last few transformer blocks, training the DWD head with pixel quality losses while anchoring the denoising head to the pretrained model to preserve the sample trajectory. Across latent image and video generators, DWD removes the decoder and reduces inference cost while maintaining or even improving pixel quality. On Wan video generation, it visibly reduces detail distortion and flickering, lowering warping error by 23%. Remarkably, the same separation also improves pixel diffusion models that do not even use a decoder: a final-step DWD head produces substantially better texture detail in text-to-image generation, and improves ImageNet FID from 1.55 to 1.43, a new state of the art among pixel flow models.

ru.title: Без декодера — прямо к пикселям
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают метод Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD), который убирает декодер из латентных диффузионных моделей. Дообученный diffusion transformer с помощью линейной головы напрямую предсказывает пиксели на финальном шаге. Исходная denoising-голова продолжает управлять сэмплированием, а новая DWD-голова обучается с pixel-quality лоссами, при этом траектория сэмплирования сохраняется за счёт привязки к предобученной модели. Метод снижает стоимость инференса и улучшает качество изображений и видео, включая снижение warping error на 23% для Wan, а также улучшает FID на ImageNet до 1.43.

en.title: Generate Pixels Directly, Without the Decoder
en.desc: Latent diffusion models typically use a decoder to convert denoised latents into pixels, which adds computation at inference time. Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD) adds a final-step prediction head to a finetuned diffusion transformer, while the original denoising head continues to guide sampling. The method finetunes only the last few transformer blocks, trains the new head with pixel-quality losses, and anchors the denoising head to preserve the pretrained sampling trajectory. DWD removes the decoder and can improve image and video quality, including reducing warping error by 23% for Wan video generation and lowering ImageNet FID from 1.55 to 1.43 for pixel flow models.

zh.title: 去掉解码器，让扩散模型最后一步直出高质量像素
zh.desc: 潜在扩散模型通常需要解码器把去噪后的潜变量转换成像素，这会增加模型复杂度和推理成本。本文提出“无解码器解码”（DWD），在微调后的扩散 Transformer 上增加一个线性预测头，让模型在最后一步直接生成像素。DWD 将像素预测与原有去噪过程分开：去噪头仍负责采样轨迹，而新预测头负责输出最终像素，并通过只微调少数 Transformer 模块来降低训练成本。在图像和视频生成中，DWD 移除了额外解码器且维持或提升像素质量；在 Wan 视频生成中，它将变形误差降低了 23%，在 ImageNet 像素流模型上则将 FID 从 1.55 降至 1.43。

papers.title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract A large-scale benchmark of 94 curated biomedical tabular datasets standardizes evaluation across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks and finds that foundation models lead overall while tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain competitive under cost constraints.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.

ru.title: В биомедицинском табличном ML лучшая модель зависит от задачи и бюджета
ru.desc: Статья представляет TabBioMed — крупный бенчмарк из 94 отобранных публичных биомедицинских табличных датасетов, охватывающих EHR, drug discovery, геномику, транскриптомику, протеомику, метаболомику, single-cell omics и системную биологию. Авторы унифицируют предобработку и evaluation-протокол, что позволяет воспроизводимо сравнивать модели для задач классификации, регрессии и multi-target. Сравниваются 23 модели: классические baseline-методы, gradient-boosted trees, нейросетевые табличные архитектуры и tabular foundation models. Результаты показывают, что foundation models в среднем лидируют, но деревья решений и тюненый MLP остаются конкурентоспособными при ограничениях на стоимость инференса и обучения, поэтому выбор модели сильно зависит от контекста.

en.title: A Practical Benchmark for Choosing Biomedical Tabular Models
en.desc: The paper introduces TabBioMed, a benchmark of 94 biomedical tabular datasets covering areas such as health records, drug discovery, and omics. It provides consistent preprocessing and evaluation to compare 23 models on classification, regression, and multi-target prediction tasks. Tabular foundation models perform best overall, but gradient-boosted trees and carefully tuned multilayer perceptrons can be strong alternatives, especially when computation is limited. The benchmark and its released tools support reproducible comparisons and help researchers choose models based on the data, task, and available resources.

zh.title: 生物医学表格学习：基础模型领先，模型选择仍需看数据与成本
zh.desc: 本文提出了 TabBioMed，这是一个包含 94 个整理过的生物医学表格数据集的大规模基准，覆盖电子健康记录、药物发现和多种组学数据。它通过统一的数据预处理与评估流程，比较分类、回归和多目标预测任务中的 23 种模型。总体上，表格基础模型的预测表现最强，但其优势会随数据类型和任务条件变化；在训练或推理成本受限时，树模型和经过调优的多层感知机仍很有竞争力。该基准及其数据划分、代码和结果有助于开展可复现的模型比较，并根据数据特点与计算预算选择合适方法。

papers.title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
papers.abstract: Abstract  Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues. Both add inference overhead, and the generated layout often drifts from the ground truth. We present WaveView, which injects the warped source into the phase of the initial noise of a pretrained generator. The Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform (DT-CWPT) allows local and anisotropic phase injection. The generator is thus constrained less in disoccluded regions and along the epipolar line. WaveView keeps the architecture and adds negligible overhead. On the DL3DV benchmark, it outperforms all baselines in every overlap bin. In the hardest bin, it gains 0.84 dB PSNR on the covisible region over MetaView, which shares its generator, while running 2.1 times faster. For dynamic NVS, fine-tuning AnyView with the same noise raises its zero-shot PSNR on AnyViewBench from 11.58 to 12.35 dB.
affiliations: FZI Research Center for Information Technology, Germany

ru.title: Волновая фаза вместо дрейфа: точный синтез новых ракурсов без лишних затрат
ru.desc: В статье представлен метод WaveView для генеративного синтеза новых ракурсов (NVS), который внедряет искажённое исходное изображение в фазу начального шума предобученного генератора на основе диффузионной модели. Для этого используется Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform (DT-CWPT), позволяющее локальную и анизотропную инжекцию фазы, что снижает ограничения генератора в зонах окклюзии и вдоль эпиполярной линии. Метод сохраняет архитектуру модели, почти не добавляет накладных расходов на inference и превосходит базовые методы на бенчмарке DL3DV, включая MetaView, при более высокой скорости работы в 2.1 раза. Также показано, что дообучение AnyView с той же инициализацией шума повышает zero-shot PSNR на AnyViewBench для динамических сцен.

en.title: Guide diffusion with warped-image phase, not extra machinery
en.desc: WaveView generates a new camera view of a scene by guiding a pretrained diffusion model with the warped source image. It injects this image into the phase of the model’s initial noise, using the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform to control guidance locally and differently by direction. This lets the model stay faithful to visible regions while generating more freely in occluded areas, with almost no added inference cost. WaveView outperforms the tested baselines on DL3DV, runs 2.1 times faster than MetaView in the hardest overlap bin, and also improves zero-shot results for dynamic view synthesis after fine-tuning.

zh.title: 把几何线索注入噪声相位，让新视角生成更准更快
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 WaveView，用扩散模型根据目标相机视角生成新的场景图像。它把源图像经过几何变换后的内容注入生成器初始噪声的相位中，而不是额外增加复杂模块。借助双树复小波包变换，方法能局部、按方向控制注入，让遮挡后新显露的区域和极线方向上的生成更灵活。实验显示，WaveView 在 DL3DV 各重叠度设置下优于基线，并且比共享同一生成器的 MetaView 快 2.1 倍；用于动态场景时，微调也提升了零样本 PSNR。

papers.title: Tideway: Phase-Aware Tiered Memory Management for MoE Inference on Consumer Devices
papers.abstract: Abstract TIDEWAY enables efficient inference of large Mixture-of-Experts models on memory-constrained consumer devices by treating host RAM and GPU VRAM as a unified memory pool with phase-aware layouts and optimized CUDA Graph execution under expert paging.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly becoming a dominant paradigm for AI applications. Recently, there is a growing demand to deploy large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models locally on consumer PCs to balance data privacy, API costs, and inference efficiency. However, unlike datacenter servers with abundant DRAM, consumer devices are tightly constrained in both GPU VRAM and host RAM, forcing massive MoE weights to spill across VRAM, host RAM, and SSD. Under such spilling, we observe that existing systems fail to fully utilize this memory hierarchy, treating the tiers as independent caches and thrashing in inference.   We present TIDEWAY, a system for efficient inference of large MoE models on memory-constrained consumer devices. Our core insight is to manage host RAM and GPU VRAM as a unified memory pool. Within this pool, TIDEWAY couples phase-aware memory layouts, which adapt to the distinct access patterns of prefill and decode, with an execution engine that optimizes CUDA Graph execution under expert paging. Our evaluations on representative consumer hardware with frontier MoE models demonstrate that TIDEWAY significantly outperforms state-of-the-art systems. On average, TIDEWAY achieves speedups of 1.97x in end-to-end latency and 2.40x in Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), along with 1.61x higher decode throughput against the fastest baseline.   Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Afterglow231/Tideway .

ru.title: Единая память для больших MoE-моделей на домашнем ПК
ru.desc: TIDEWAY — это система для эффективного инференса больших MoE-моделей (Mixture-of-Experts) на потребительских ПК с ограниченной памятью. Ключевая идея заключается в том, чтобы рассматривать оперативную память хоста (host RAM) и видеопамять GPU (VRAM) как единый пул памяти с учётом фаз prefill и decode. Система сочетает такие раскладки памяти с оптимизированным выполнением CUDA Graph при expert paging, что уменьшает трэшинг между уровнями памяти.
