По результатам экспериментов TIDEWAY ускоряет end-to-end задержку в 1.97 раза, TTFT в 2.40 раза и пропускную способность декодирования в 1.61 раза относительно лучших базовых решений.

en.title: One Memory Pool, Faster MoE Inference
en.desc: TIDEWAY makes large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models faster to run on consumer PCs with limited memory. It manages GPU VRAM and host RAM as one shared memory pool, rather than treating them as separate caches. Its memory layouts adapt to the different access patterns of prefill and decode, while its execution engine optimizes CUDA Graphs as experts are paged in and out. Tests show faster end-to-end inference, quicker time to first token, and higher decode throughput than the fastest competing system.

zh.title: 打通内存与显存，让大型 MoE 在消费级设备上跑得更快
zh.desc: TIDEWAY 面向显存和内存受限的消费级设备，让大型混合专家模型（MoE）能够更高效地运行。它将主机内存（RAM）和显卡显存（VRAM）作为统一的内存池管理，减少权重在不同存储层之间搬运造成的浪费。系统还根据提示词处理（prefill）和逐词生成（decode）的不同访问模式调整内存布局，并优化专家分页时的 CUDA Graph 执行。实验表明，相比最快的基线系统，TIDEWAY 的端到端延迟平均降低约 1.97 倍、首词生成时间（TTFT）提升约 2.40 倍，解码吞吐量提升 1.61 倍。

papers.title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.

ru.title: Агент сам находит лучший рецепт квантизации LLM без потери скорости
ru.desc: Статья представляет QDA — систему, в которой LLM-агент сам подбирает рецепт post-training quantization для каждой модели и каждого формата точности. Для быстрой оценки кандидатов используется KL-дивергенция выходов относительно исходной модели на скрытых reasoning-трассах, а перспективные варианты проверяются длинными генерациями, чтобы выявлять сбои вроде циклов повторений. Библиотека совместимых PTQ-методов позволяет легко переносить их на новые архитектуры, включая MoE. На четырёх reasoning-моделях QDA превосходит лучший публичный рецепт по точности и не добавляет накладных расходов на инференс.

en.title: Let an agent find the right quantization recipe
en.desc: QDA uses an LLM agent to design post-training quantization recipes for each model and precision. It quickly evaluates candidate recipes by comparing their output distributions with the original model using KL divergence on hidden reasoning traces, then tests promising candidates with longer generations to detect failures. A compatible library of quantization methods makes it easier to build recipes for different model architectures. Across several reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over strong public recipes, while its checkpoints run on existing serving kernels without extra inference overhead.

zh.title: 让智能体自动设计量化方案，低成本守住模型精度
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了 QDA 系统，让大语言模型智能体为不同模型和精度自动设计训练后量化（PTQ）方案。QDA 用与原始模型输出的 KL 散度快速评估候选方案，再通过较长文本生成检查重复循环等问题，并提供兼容不同方法与新架构的量化工具库。实验显示，QDA 在多种低比特精度下提升了推理模型准确率；在 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 NVFP4 W4A4 量化中，其准确率达到 FP8 模型的 98.3%。生成的模型可直接使用现有推理内核运行，无需额外推理开销。

papers.title: PIPETTE: Prompt Injection Purple-Teaming for Robust LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract A novel framework addresses the limitations of current reinforcement learning-based red-teaming methods by employing dictionary learning and on-policy adversarial training to improve the robustness of LLM agents against indirect prompt injection attacks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks. To uncover these vulnerabilities at scale, automated red-teaming methods often leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to generate attacks that achieve high attack success rates (ASR). Model developers use the attacks discovered during internal red-teaming to harden agents through adversarial training before deployment, a collaborative offensive-defensive process known in cybersecurity as purple-teaming. However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training. Specifically, we find that two state-of-the-art RL-based red-teaming methods, RL-Hammer and PISmith, suffer from mode collapse, repeatedly discovering similar attack strategies whose additional successes add no additional robustness improvements to adversarial training. To address this gap, we introduce PIPETTE, a unified prompt injection purple-teaming framework that effectively converts red-teaming discoveries into defender robustness improvements. PIPETTE employs a dictionary learning-based reward that encourages broader coverage of attack strategies during red-teaming. It also integrates an on-policy adversarial training pipeline tailored to IPI defense, enabling agents to resist attacks while completing legitimate user tasks. Extensive evaluations across agentic benchmarks (AgentDojo and ASB) demonstrate that PIPETTE produces defenders that achieve near-zero attack success rates on static attacks and can withstand strong adaptive attacks, while maintaining benign task utility close to that of the undefended baseline.

ru.title: Разнообразие атак — ключ к надёжной защите LLM-агентов
ru.desc: Статья показывает, что методы автоматического red-teaming на основе reinforcement learning, такие как RL-Hammer и PISmith, страдают от mode collapse: они находят похожие атаки, и обучение на них не повышает устойчивость агентов. Авторы предлагают PIPETTE — фреймворк для purple-teaming, где reward на основе dictionary learning поощряет разнообразие стратегий атак. Также используется on-policy adversarial training, который учит LLM-агентов защищаться от indirect prompt injection и выполнять легитимные задачи. Эксперименты на AgentDojo и ASB показывают почти нулевой ASR на статических атаках и устойчивость к адаптивным атакам при сохранении полезности агента.

en.title: Broader Attacks, Stronger Agent Defenses
en.desc: The paper studies how indirect prompt injection attacks can hijack language-model agents that use untrusted external data. It finds that existing reinforcement-learning red-team methods often suffer from mode collapse: they repeatedly generate similar attacks, so high attack success rates do not necessarily lead to stronger defenses. The proposed PIPETTE framework uses dictionary learning to reward diverse attack strategies and on-policy adversarial training to teach agents to resist them while carrying out legitimate tasks. Evaluations show that PIPETTE greatly reduces success of both static and adaptive attacks while preserving most benign task performance.

zh.title: 让红队攻击更有多样性，让智能体防御更有效
zh.desc: 本文研究大型语言模型智能体遭受间接提示注入攻击时的安全问题。作者发现，现有基于强化学习的红队方法容易发生模式坍塌，反复生成相似攻击，因此攻击成功率高并不一定能提升防御能力。为此，PIPETTE 使用基于字典学习的奖励来拓宽攻击策略覆盖范围，并结合针对间接提示注入的在线策略对抗训练。实验显示，该方法能大幅降低静态攻击的成功率、抵御强自适应攻击，同时较好地保持智能体完成正常任务的能力。

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
papers.abstract: Abstract AnyS1 converts procedural skills into shared decision points, trains a small calibrated pointer model to resolve routine choices, and falls back to a large model when uncertain, reducing cost and latency while preserving reliability.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Маленькая модель решает рутину, большая — только когда сомневается
ru.desc: В статье предложен фреймворк AnyS1, который превращает процедурные навыки (skills), описанные людьми, в общие точки принятия решений (decision points). Небольшая калиброванная модель-указатель на 4B параметров, обученная с label smoothing, решает рутинные выборы за один прямой проход, а при низкой уверенности передаёт задачу большой LLM (System-2). Такой подход снижает стоимость и задержку работы автономных LLM-агентов на 75–91% и 63–92% соответственно, сохраняя надёжность выполнения задач. Метод также устойчив на новых бенчмарках и при zero-shot переносе порога уверенности.

en.title: Let a small model handle routine choices
en.desc: AnyS1 uses procedural skills to identify decision points where an agent chooses among a known set of options. It trains a compact 4B pointer model, called System-1, to handle these routine choices in one pass. When the model is uncertain, the agent falls back to a larger System-2 model, preserving reliability. Tests on unseen benchmarks show that AnyS1 reduces cost by 75–91% and model-call time by 63–92% while maintaining task performance.

zh.title: 常规决策交给小模型，难题再请大模型
zh.desc: AnyS1 将人类编写的流程技能转化为共享的决策点，让智能体识别哪些步骤可以从有限选项中直接选择。研究团队用这些决策点和实际执行轨迹构建数据集，并训练一个经过校准的 4B 参数指针模型作为轻量级 System-1。运行时，System-1 用一次前向计算处理有把握的常规选择；当置信度低于阈值时，系统会交由大型 System-2 模型处理。实验显示，在保持任务可靠性的同时，AnyS1 将单次任务成本降低 75%–91%、模型调用时间降低 63%–92%，且能迁移到未见过的任务基准和模型家族。

papers.title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract UltraTex employs a cascaded multi-view framework that integrates physical knowledge and vision-language model features to accurately generate physically plausible PBR texture maps.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.

ru.title: Физически правдоподобные текстуры для 3D по одному фото
ru.desc: UltraTex — это каскадный мультиракурсный фреймворк, который генерирует PBR-текстуры (albedo, metallic и roughness) для 3D-меша по одному референсному изображению. Сначала модель совместно предсказывает albedo и нормали в мировых координатах, а затем на их основе оценивает карты metallic-roughness. Для учёта материалов используется lightweight adapter, который переводит скрытые признаки VLM в токены материальных представлений, а photometric representation alignment направляет промежуточные признаки диффузионной модели к реалистичному рендерингу без явного обучения на освещении. Эксперименты показывают, что по качеству, точности материалов и физической правдоподобности UltraTex превосходит как открытые, так и коммерческие аналоги.

en.title: From One Image to Physically Plausible 3D Materials
en.desc: UltraTex generates physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image using a cascaded, multi-view diffusion framework. It first predicts albedo and surface normals, then estimates metallic and roughness maps using the generated albedo, the image, and material cues from a vision-language model. The method also aligns intermediate diffusion features with renderings under controlled lighting, helping it infer material properties from highlights and reflections. Experiments show that UltraTex produces more visually faithful and physically plausible textures than existing methods.

zh.title: 从外观到材质：让 PBR 纹理生成更懂物理
zh.desc: UltraTex 提出一种级联多视角框架，从单张参考图像为 3D 网格生成符合物理规律的 PBR 纹理。它先联合预测反照率贴图和世界空间着色法线，再根据生成的反照率、参考图像及材料语义先验预测金属度与粗糙度贴图。模型使用视觉语言模型特征提供部件级材料知识，并通过光度表征对齐，让扩散模型的中间特征学习材料在受控光照下的反射表现。实验表明，该方法生成的纹理在视觉保真度、材料属性准确性和物理合理性方面优于现有方法。

papers.title: VAE Rhythm: Temporal Decoding Traces for AI-Generated Video Detection
papers.abstract: Abstract  Visible artifacts are an unreliable cue for detecting generated videos, because newer generators learn to remove them. We instead detect a trace left by the generation pipeline itself. Most video generators decode latents with a 3D causal VAE that groups consecutive frames in time, so the fidelity of generated frames rises and falls periodically with their position in a group. We call this periodic trace VAE Rhythm. Real videos are captured frame by frame and do not have it. To reveal it without training, we propose a phase scan. The scan reconstructs a clip with an off-the-shelf VAE from successive start offsets and measures the periodicity of the reconstruction error across these offsets. We find VAE Rhythm in most of the 39 variants of 31 generators we test, including the closed-source Sora, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0. We use the rhythm as a zero-shot score, as a plug-in for existing detectors and as a data engine that pairs real videos with their VAE reconstructions to train our detector CaDet. On DF26, the training-free rhythm score outperforms all 15 retrained baselines, and as a plug-in it improves all 19 tested detectors by 6.7% to 23.7% AUROC. CaDet achieves the best AUROC on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and its variant trained without any generated video still exceeds 90% on AIGVDBench.

ru.title: Ритм VAE выдаёт сгенерированное видео
ru.desc: Статья предлагает способ обнаруживать сгенерированные видео по следу, который оставляет сам пайплайн генерации, а не по видимым артефактам, которые новые модели научились убирать. Большинство генераторов декодируют латенты через 3D causal VAE, который группирует соседние кадры, поэтому качество кадров periodically меняется в зависимости от позиции в группе; это явление авторы называют VAE Rhythm. Для его выявления без обучения предложен phase scan: видео реконструируется готовым VAE со смещением начала и измеряется периодичность ошибки реконструкции. Ритм найден у большинства из 39 вариантов 31 генератора, включая закрытые модели, а на его основе созданы zero-shot метрика, плагин для существующих детекторов и детектор CaDet.

en.title: Detect the Hidden Rhythm Left by Video Generators
en.desc: This paper detects AI-generated videos by finding a periodic pattern in frame quality caused by the 3D causal VAE used in many video generators. The authors call this pattern “VAE Rhythm” and reveal it with a phase scan that measures reconstruction errors at different starting offsets, without training a model. The rhythm works as a zero-shot detection score and improves existing detectors; it also provides training data for CaDet. Their method outperforms tested baselines on several benchmarks and generalizes to some generators it was not trained on.

zh.title: 不看表面伪影，追踪生成器留下的 VAE 节律
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出一种检测 AI 生成视频的方法，称为“VAE 节律”：生成器使用 3D 因果变分自编码器（VAE）按时间分组解码帧，使帧的重建保真度随帧在组中的位置周期性变化，而真实视频没有这种规律。研究者提出无需训练的“相位扫描”，通过改变视频片段的起始偏移，用现成 VAE 重建片段，并测量重建误差是否呈现周期性。实验发现，这种节律存在于测试的 31 个生成器的多数版本中，并可作为零样本检测分数、现有检测器的插件，或用于构造训练数据。其检测器 CaDet 在多个基准和闭源模型上取得领先表现，而不依赖可见伪影也能有效识别生成视频。

papers.title: RICoT: Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought for Page Stream Segmentation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents. Yet published LLM methods still frame the task as boundary classification over one or a few neighboring pages, and commercial document-splitting APIs do not disclose their methods. We reimagine PSS for LLMs as a sequential process over the whole stream and propose RICoT (Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought), a prompting framework that works through the pages as a reader would: within a sliding window it reasons about each page and commits its boundary decision before moving on, and across windows it carries forward a compact record of what it has read, keeping per-call cost bounded. We also introduce FinancePSS-205, a benchmark of 205 real-world, de-identified financial page streams, to be released publicly. On FinancePSS-205, RICoT matches or outperforms pairwise and windowed prompting with the same backbone for each of three open-weight LLMs; on a TABME test subset, RICoT with GLM-5 reaches document F1 0.847 and boundary F1 0.915, above published zero-shot results. A 2B-parameter student, trained on a larger teacher's decisions with and without the page-level reasoning, performs comparably in both modes and comes within 0.05 document F1 of the strongest prompted model on FinancePSS-205.

ru.title: Читать страницы по порядку, как человек: последовательная сегментация документов с LLM
ru.desc: В статье предлагается RICoT (Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought) — метод промптинга для Page Stream Segmentation, который обрабатывает весь поток страниц последовательно, как читатель, принимая решение о границе документа после рассуждения о каждой странице. Между скользящими окнами передается компактная запись прочитанного, что ограничивает стоимость каждого вызова LLM. Авторы также представляют бенчмарк FinancePSS-205 из 205 реальных деидентифицированных финансовых потоков страниц, который планируется опубликовать. На этом бенчмарке RICoT не уступает или превосходит парное и оконное промптинг с теми же open-weight LLM, а на подмножестве TABME достигает document F1 0.847. Студенческая модель на 2B параметров, обученная на решениях более крупного учителя, показывает близкие результаты в обоих режимах и отстает от лучшей промптовой модели всего на 0.05 document F1.

en.title: Read the Stream, Find the Boundaries
en.desc: Page Stream Segmentation (PSS) splits a multi-page file into separate documents by identifying boundaries between them. The paper presents RICoT, a prompting framework that processes pages sequentially, makes boundary decisions within sliding windows, and carries a compact summary across windows to limit cost. On a new benchmark of 205 de-identified financial page streams, RICoT matches or beats other prompting strategies across three open-weight language models, and achieves strong results on a TABME test subset. The authors also show that a 2-billion-parameter model trained on a larger model’s decisions performs comparably with or without page-level reasoning and comes close to the strongest prompted model.

zh.title: 逐页推理、跨窗记忆：让文档边界识别更稳更省
zh.desc: 论文将页面流分割（PSS）视为对整份文件逐页处理的序列任务，而非只判断相邻页面之间是否存在边界。作者提出 RICoT 提示框架：模型在滑动窗口中逐页推理并确定边界，同时将已读内容压缩成简要记录带到后续窗口，以控制每次调用的成本。作者还发布了包含 205 份真实、去标识化金融页面流的 FinancePSS-205 基准；实验显示，RICoT 在多种开源权重模型上达到或超过成对及窗口式提示方法，并在 TABME 子集上取得较高的文档 F1 和边界 F1。一个由大型教师模型决策训练的 20 亿参数学生模型，即使不使用页面级推理也表现相近，在 FinancePSS-205 上与最强提示模型的文档 F1 差距不到 0.05。

papers.title: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation
papers.abstract: Abstract Chorus shares one set of n-gram embedding tables across all layers, letting each layer project and rescale the embedding using its hidden state, achieving better quality with much smaller tables and lower optimizer memory.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Language models can gain capacity at little computational cost from n-gram embedding tables: large tables of learned vectors for short sequences of consecutive tokens, which are looked up and added to the model's input or to its intermediate layers. Recent designs commonly use a separate n-gram embedding table for each layer, which makes the tables costly in memory and prevents layers from sharing what they learn. Sharing a single table, however, gives every layer the same embedding and leaves no room for layer-wise preferences, and it performs poorly in practice. We propose Chorus, in which one set of n-gram embedding tables serves the whole network and every layer reads it in its own way. Each layer maps the refined embedding through its own projection layer, after rescaling its components by factors computed from its current hidden state. Chorus matches the quality of existing n-gram methods with 87% smaller tables: with 1.2B table parameters it predicts text better than FactorEngram and DeepSeek's Engram do with 9.6B. It outperforms Engram, TN-gram and FactorEngram in every setting where we compared them, across table sizes from 20M to 9.6B parameters. We also show that the recently proposed memory-efficient optimizer Ember works well with Chorus, saving 99.2% of table-optimizer memory compared with AdamW without degrading training performance. These results enable further scaling of n-gram embedding tables along the table-size axis by reducing memory use and allowing shared knowledge to be reused across layers.

ru.title: Один общий словарь n-gram эмбеддингов для всех слоёв: меньше памяти, лучше качество
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод Chorus, в котором одна общая таблица n-gram эмбеддингов используется всеми слоями нейросети вместо отдельной таблицы для каждого слоя. Каждый слой проецирует уточнённый эмбеддинг через собственный projection layer, предварительно масштабируя его компоненты с помощью коэффициентов, вычисляемых из текущего hidden state. Метод достигает качества существующих n-gram подходов при таблицах, меньших на 87%, и превосходит Engram, TN-gram и FactorEngram при размерах от 20M до 9.6B параметров. Также показано, что оптимизатор Ember с Chorus экономит 99.2% памяти оптимизатора для таблиц по сравнению с AdamW без ухудшения обучения.

en.title: One N-gram Memory, Every Layer’s Way
en.desc: Chorus uses one shared set of n-gram embedding tables across all model layers, rather than storing separate tables for each layer. Each layer adapts the shared embeddings with its own projection and scales them according to its current hidden state. This approach matches or exceeds other n-gram methods while using much smaller tables, and it can work with Ember to greatly reduce optimizer memory. Sharing and adapting the tables lets the model reuse learned information across layers while using memory more efficiently.

zh.title: 一张共享表，各层灵活读取
zh.desc: Chorus让模型的所有层共享同一组 n-gram 嵌入表，而不是为每层各自存一套表。每一层根据当前隐藏状态调整嵌入的分量，再通过自己的投影层处理，使各层能以不同方式利用共享信息。实验表明，Chorus使用的嵌入表参数量减少87%，仍能达到或超过多种已有方法的效果。结合 Ember 优化器后，表参数的优化器内存比 AdamW 减少99.2%，且不损害训练表现。

papers.title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
papers.abstract: Abstract FVSCORE is a neuro-symbolic evaluation framework that compiles videos into prompt and implicit constraint propositions, verifies them with perceptual tools and soft temporal logic, and calibrates significant violations to produce interpretable, human-aligned feedback for video generation.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments across public and complex multi-event benchmarks with the strongest video models to date, demonstrating that FVSCORE outperforms holistic and agent-based evaluators in human correlation while providing highly accurate and interpretable feedback.

ru.title: Оценивать видео по спецификации, а не на глаз: FVSCORE согласует генерацию с человеческим восприятием
ru.desc: В статье представлен FVSCORE — нейро-символьный фреймворк для оценки генерации видео по спецификации. Система разбивает видео на явные пропозиции из промпта и неявные пропозиции о физических, временных и кросс-модальных ограничениях. Каждая пропозиция проверяется специализированными перцептивными инструментами, а полученные траектории уверенности анализируются мягкими темпоральными операторами, вдохновлёнными Linear Temporal Logic. Этап Significance-Aware Calibration оставляет только значимые для восприятия нарушения, что даёт отчёт с привязкой к времени и доказательствам, лучше коррелирующий с человеческими оценками, чем LLM-судьи и агентные методы.

en.title: Evaluate Videos by Checking What Matters, When It Matters
en.desc: FVSCORE evaluates generated videos by checking whether they satisfy prompt requirements and implicit constraints, such as physical plausibility and temporal consistency. It uses specialized perceptual tools to measure each requirement and applies soft temporal logic to analyze how well it holds over time. Significance-aware calibration filters out violations that are unlikely to matter to human viewers. Experiments show that FVSCORE aligns better with human judgments than competing evaluators and provides interpretable feedback with timestamps and supporting evidence.

zh.title: 让视频评估有据可循：逐项验证要求，定位关键违规
zh.desc: 本文提出 Faithfulness Video Score（FVSCORE），一种用于评估视频生成结果是否符合要求的神经符号框架。它将视频内容拆解为提示词明确要求的命题，以及有关物理规律、时间顺序和跨模态一致性的隐含命题，再利用专门的感知工具进行验证。框架通过受线性时序逻辑启发的软时序算子分析验证结果，并校准显著性，只保留人们容易察觉的重要违规。实验表明，FVSCORE 比整体式或基于智能体的评估方法更符合人类判断，还能提供带时间戳和证据的可解释反馈。

papers.title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract  Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.

ru.title: Учим агентную модель искать нужные кадры в длинном видео, а не просто отвечать на вопрос
ru.desc: Статья представляет NexSight — фреймворк для создания проверяемых задач на понимание длинных видео, где агентная LLM-модель должна находить разрозненные короткие фрагменты для ответа на вопросы о количестве, порядке и моментах изменения событий. Конвейер SightForge отбирает задачи только тогда, когда независимый верификатор, не видящий черновой ответ, может восстановить их из плотно повторно извлечённых кадров, а контрпримеры не опровергают ответ. Получившийся бенчмарк SightLine (310 задач на 108 видео) оценивается через SightLoop, а траектории решений используются как пошаговый supervision для обучения решений о наблюдении. Модель Sight-35B, дообученная менее чем на 6 тысячах примеров, почти удваивает точность базовой модели и превосходит более крупную модель своего семейства, сохраняя улучшения на внешних бенчмарках.

en.title: Teach video agents to find—and verify—the moments that matter
en.desc: This paper introduces NexSight, a framework for evaluating and training AI agents to answer detailed questions about long videos. Its SightForge pipeline verifies each task by checking that evidence gathered from the raw video supports the answer and that counterexamples do not disprove it. The resulting SightLine benchmark contains 310 evidence-traceable tasks, while SightLoop records agents’ video exploration and inspection decisions. Training on fewer than 6,000 step-level examples substantially improves an agent’s interactive accuracy, though the gap between its score and its performance with annotated evidence shows that finding evidence remains difficult.

zh.title: 不只给答案，更要学会在长视频中找到证据
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 NexSight，用于评估和训练模型理解长视频中的细节问题，例如统计动作次数、判断事件顺序和定位状态变化。它通过 SightForge 筛选可验证的任务：独立验证者必须能从原始视频中重新找到充分证据，反例检查也不能推翻答案。研究者据此构建了包含310个任务的 SightLine，并用 SightLoop 记录模型在不同时间尺度上搜索、检查和整合证据的过程。实验显示，模型直接作答的准确率仍有限，但少于6000个步骤级训练样本，就能显著提升模型主动寻找证据的能力，并改善外部基准表现。

papers.title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
papers.abstract: Abstract A new metric for automatic CAD generation evaluates models through engineering-drawing projections with a saturating penalty along curves, exposing small local errors that volume- or surface-based metrics miss and enabling use as a reinforcement learning reward or test-time verifier.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the (k+q)-th power of its size, where k is the dimension of the integration domain and q is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agents, DrawScore exposes errors in outputs that IoU rates as nearly perfect. DrawScore further improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward and, for CAD generation from engineering drawings, serves as a test-time verifier without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model. Our code is available at https://github.com/UESTC-Simon/DrawScore.
