ru.title: Чертёж видит то, что не видит объём: локальные ошибки CAD больше не ускользают
ru.desc: Статья предлагает новую метрику DrawScore для оценки автоматической генерации CAD-моделей. Модели проецируются в три ортогональных вида с видимыми и скрытыми линиями, как на инженерных чертежах, и штраф применяется вдоль проекций. Авторы показывают, что привычные метрики IoU, Chamfer Distance и F-score почти не замечают малые локальные ошибки, а DrawScore их выявляет. Метрику также можно использовать как reward для reinforcement learning и как верификатор на этапе инференса без 3D ground truth.

en.title: DrawScore: Catch Small CAD Errors That Other Metrics Miss
en.desc: The paper introduces DrawScore, a metric for evaluating automatically generated CAD models. It compares engineering-style projections from three orthographic views and uses a saturating penalty along projected curves, making small but important errors—such as a misplaced hole—more visible than with volumetric IoU or surface-based metrics. The authors show that common metrics underweight local errors as those errors get smaller, while DrawScore’s penalty decreases only linearly. DrawScore can also serve as a reinforcement learning reward and a test-time verifier when 3D ground truth is unavailable.

zh.title: 让工程图投影看见 CAD 模型的细微错误
zh.desc: 论文提出 DrawScore，用于评估自动 CAD 生成结果。它将模型投影到三个正交视图，并根据工程图中的可见线和隐藏线，对投影曲线上的误差施加饱和惩罚。与体积 IoU、Chamfer 距离和表面 F-score 相比，该指标能更敏感地发现错位孔洞等局部错误。DrawScore 还可作为强化学习奖励，或在没有三维真值和额外奖励模型时充当测试时验证器。

papers.title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. Rather than scoring the full dialogue prefix, ECA queries a frozen snapshot of the current policy under an evidence-only prompt containing solely the question and the deduplicated documents observed so far, isolating the utility of retrieved passages from surface variations in generated thoughts or search queries. Within this framework, we compare two return formulations, ECA-Step (which accumulates step-clipped potential increments) and ECA-Horizon (which preserves the telescoping horizon gain in potential), paired with cross-fold group normalization, novelty gating, and search-local token assignment. Across seven Search QA benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves strict macro exact match over an outcome-only GRPO baseline by 1.03 and 4.80 percentage points on Qwen2.5-3B- and 7B-Instruct, respectively, outperforming both RLOO and GiGPO. Zero-shot evaluation on MultiHop-RAG further demonstrates strong transfer to multi-hop inference queries.
affiliations: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Награждаем не только ответ, но и полезный поиск
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA) для обучения языковых моделей с подкреплением (RL) при поиске информации. Проблема в том, что обычный outcome-based GRPO присваивает одинаковую награду всем поисковым запросам траектории, и при провале всех rollout'ов advantage обнуляется. ECA добавляет вспомогательный сигнал, измеряющий, насколько найденные документы повышают правдоподобие эталонного ответа, используя замороженную копию политики. Эксперименты на семи бенчмарках Search QA показывают прирост точности по сравнению с GRPO, RLOO и GiGPO на моделях Qwen2.5-3B и 7B.

en.title: Reward the evidence that leads to the answer
en.desc: The paper introduces Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA) for training search-augmented language models with reinforcement learning. ECA adds a training-only reward that measures how retrieved documents change the model’s likelihood of a reference answer, helping distinguish useful searches even when complete answer attempts fail. It evaluates two ways to assign this evidence-based reward across search steps, and finds that ECA-Horizon performs best when combined with techniques such as novelty gating and search-local token assignment. Across seven search question-answering benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves exact-match accuracy over outcome-only GRPO and transfers well to multi-hop questions.

zh.title: 让有用证据获得应有的奖励
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出证据式信用分配（ECA），用于训练能够边推理边检索的语言模型。传统的终局奖励会给一条轨迹中的所有搜索相同的功劳，即使检索到的信息价值不同；如果所有尝试都答错，也难以区分哪些轨迹收集了更有用的证据。ECA 使用冻结的当前策略，仅根据问题和去重后的检索文档，估计这些证据提升参考答案概率的程度，并将其作为训练时的辅助信号。实验显示，保留整体证据增益的 ECA-Horizon 在多个搜索问答基准上优于仅使用终局奖励的方法，并能迁移到多跳推理任务。

papers.title: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract Across three shopping benchmarks, increasing large language model shopping agents' thinking effort did not statistically improve product-choice quality but significantly raised reported confidence, and most models were poorly calibrated with correlated errors.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.

ru.title: Больше размышлений — больше уверенности, но не больше правоты
ru.desc: Авторы исследуют, улучшает ли увеличение «глубины размышлений» качество выбора товаров у LLM-агентов для покупок, которые обрабатывают мультимодальные карточки товаров. Тестировались десять передовых моделей на трёх бенчмарках, построенных на основе WebShop, SQID от Amazon и WANDS от Wayfair. Результаты показали, что рост thinking effort статистически значимо не повышает качество решений, но заметно увеличивает заявленную уверенность модели. Кроме того, большинство моделей плохо откалиброваны, а их ошибки сильно коррелированы: часто они ошибаются на одних и тех же задачах и выбирают один и тот же неверный товар.

en.title: More Thinking, More Confidence—Not Better Choices
en.desc: The paper tests ten large language models as shopping agents on three product-choice benchmarks. Increasing their thinking effort did not meaningfully improve how often they chose the right product. However, it significantly increased their reported confidence, even though most models were poorly calibrated, meaning confidence did not reliably match accuracy. Models also often made correlated errors, sometimes choosing the same wrong product.

zh.title: 多想不一定选得更对，却可能更有信心
zh.desc: 这项研究在 WebShop、Amazon SQID 和 Wayfair WANDS 三个购物基准上，评测了十种前沿大语言模型的商品选择能力。结果显示，提高模型的思考力度并未显著提升选择质量，却显著提高了模型表达的信心。多数模型的信心与实际正确率并不匹配，因此校准能力较差。不同模型的错误往往彼此相关，而且常会在同一任务上选中相同的错误商品。

papers.title: Learning Anisotropic Prediction Targets for Flow Models
papers.abstract: Abstract AnisoFlow learns an anisotropic, learnable prediction target for flow-based generative models, improving FID and image quality without altering the architecture or sampler.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Flow-based generative models are trained on a hand-chosen prediction target, such as the velocity, the noise, or the clean data. This choice strongly affects training and sample quality. We introduce Anisotropic Flow Models (AnisoFlow), which replaces a fixed prediction target with a fully learnable one. AnisoFlow learns to scale the noise component of the target anisotropically, assigning a separate nonnegative weight to each direction in a jointly learned basis. A closed-form map recovers the velocity from the network's prediction, leaving the architecture, flow-matching loss, and sampler unchanged. Since recovery is exact, training optimizes the target purely to make it easier for the network to predict. We theoretically analyze the resulting prediction error and predict that the preferred noise weight in each direction scales near-linearly with data variance, in agreement with the weights learned empirically in pixel space. AnisoFlow improves FID from 1.90 to 1.55 over the JiT baseline on ImageNet 256times256, by learning only the prediction target, without representation alignment or architectural changes. In pixel-space text-to-image generation, AnisoFlow improves image quality and, through better-conditioned velocity recovery, largely removes patch-seam artifacts under reduced-precision inference.

ru.title: Учим модель, что именно предсказывать, — и генерация становится лучше
ru.desc: Статья предлагает AnisoFlow — метод для flow-based генеративных моделей, в котором фиксированная цель предсказания заменяется полностью обучаемой. Модель учит анизотропные весовые коэффициенты для компоненты шума в обученном базисе, а замкнутая формула восстанавливает velocity из предсказания сети, поэтому архитектура, loss flow-matching и sampler не меняются. Теоретически показано, что оптимальный вес шума по каждому направлению почти линейно зависит от дисперсии данных, что подтверждается экспериментально в пиксельном пространстве. На ImageNet 256×256 метод улучшает FID с 1.90 до 1.55 относительно базовой модели JiT, а в text-to-image генерации уменьшает артефакты на стыках патчей при инференсе в пониженной точности.

en.title: Let the Model Learn the Target for Better Flow-Based Generation
en.desc: AnisoFlow makes the prediction target in flow-based generative models learnable instead of choosing a fixed target such as noise or velocity. It learns nonnegative noise weights for different directions in a jointly learned basis, then uses an exact formula to recover velocity from the model’s prediction. This lets training choose targets that are easier for the network to predict, while keeping the architecture, flow-matching loss, and sampler unchanged. AnisoFlow improves FID and image quality, and its better-conditioned velocity recovery reduces patch-seam artifacts in reduced-precision text-to-image generation.

zh.title: 让预测目标自适应学习，提升流生成质量
zh.desc: 流生成模型通常需要预先选定预测目标，例如速度、噪声或干净数据，而这种选择会影响训练和生成质量。AnisoFlow让模型学习预测目标：在共同学习的基底中，为不同方向的噪声分量分别学习非负权重。通过闭式映射，模型仍可精确恢复速度，因此无需更改网络架构、流匹配损失或采样器，学习目标也专注于让网络更容易预测。实验显示，AnisoFlow在ImageNet 256×256上将FID从1.90降至1.55，并提升像素空间文生图质量，且在低精度推理时大幅减少图像块接缝伪影。

papers.title: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
papers.abstract: Abstract Withholding training data delays but does not prevent language models from acquiring skills, and models can regain withheld capabilities with less data as they improve.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.
affiliations: Budapest University of Technology and Economics (BME), Budapest, Hungary

ru.title: Фильтрация данных откладывает навык, но не отменяет его
ru.desc: Исследование показывает, что удаление обучающих данных для отдельных навыков языковых моделей (LLM) лишь откладывает их освоение, но не предотвращает его. Общий прогресс модели на остальной части данных частично замещает отсутствующий сигнал: например, модель для шахмат, никогда не обучавшаяся отвечать на шах, почти так же хорошо ранжирует legal moves. Когда отсутствующие данные возвращаются, модель осваивает навык, используя лишь малую долю данных, и эта доля уменьшается по мере роста модели. Таким образом, фильтрация данных задерживает возможности AI, но требуемый объём данных для их восстановления со временем снижается.

en.title: Withheld Data Delays Skills—It Doesn’t Erase Them
en.desc: The study tests whether withholding training examples can stop language models from learning particular skills. Across tasks such as chess, molecular strings, and web text, progress on other training data partly substitutes for the withheld examples, so withholding delays a skill rather than preventing it. Larger models’ delays could be predicted using results from smaller models, and models sometimes showed signs of an untrained capability, such as ranking legal chess moves after check. As training progressed, models needed less withheld data to acquire the skill, while a similarly difficult control rule was learned more slowly.

zh.title: 屏蔽数据只能延缓能力，模型越进步越容易补回
zh.desc: 本文研究训练时暂时屏蔽某项技能的数据，能否阻止模型学会该技能。实验涵盖棋类、分子字符串、括号语言和网页文本等任务，发现模型从其他数据中获得的进步也能帮助它掌握被屏蔽的技能，因此屏蔽数据只能延缓能力出现，不能彻底阻止。模型越成熟，之后重新训练被屏蔽数据时，所需数据量就越少；例如，未专门学过“应对将军”的棋类模型，也能较好地为合法应对方式排序。研究还发现，较小模型中的延迟情况可以预测较大模型的表现，这说明数据过滤的效果会受到模型整体训练进展的影响。

papers.title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
papers.abstract: Abstract  Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. MRPD samples nothing and calls no environment or reward model: the trainer is the sole process, and consolidating the experts costs only about a seventh of the compute used to train them. On three long-horizon agentic domains (reasoning, search and SQL), MRPD yields the best student model, substantially outperforming online RL baselines, and surpassing MOPD from the same experts at a fraction of MOPD's cost. Our analysis on the same logs shows that the replayed trajectories carry most of the gain, and that both the policy gradient and the distillation term add to it. Most interestingly, the order of the logs matters more than their amount or rewards, suggesting that expert training logs are a curriculum, not a data mixture.

ru.title: Логи экспертов — это учебный план, а не просто данные
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают метод MRPD (multi-expert replay policy distillation), который объединяет несколько RL-экспертов в одну модель, не генерируя новых данных. Вместо дорогой дистилляции (MOPD) модель просто проигрывает логи обучения экспертов в том же порядке, пересчитывая policy gradient и дистиллируя распределения финальных экспертов по залогированным префиксам. Такой подход почти не требует вычислений: около одной седьмой стоимости обучения экспертов, а качество выше, чем у онлайн RL и MOPD. Интересный вывод: порядок логов важнее их объёма и наград, то есть обучающие логи работают как учебный план (curriculum), а не как простая смесь данных.

en.title: Replay the Experts’ Journey to Build a Stronger Student
en.desc: The paper introduces multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), a way to combine domain-specific reinforcement learning experts into one student model. Instead of generating new rollouts, MRPD replays the experts’ saved training trajectories in the order they were learned, recomputing policy gradients and distilling expert action distributions at recorded prefixes. This makes consolidation cheaper than multi-teacher on-policy distillation while keeping training closer to the student’s current policy. Across reasoning, search, and SQL tasks, MRPD outperforms comparison methods, and results suggest that the order of training logs acts like a curriculum.

zh.title: 按专家学习轨迹回放，让蒸馏更省算、更有效
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出多专家回放策略蒸馏（MRPD），把各领域专家通过强化学习产生的训练轨迹，按专家学习时的顺序回放给学生模型。训练时，方法在这些已评分轨迹上重新计算策略梯度，并在记录的前缀处蒸馏最终专家的策略分布；整个过程不需要重新采样，也不调用环境或奖励模型。按专家原有轨迹顺序训练能减少训练与推理之间的不匹配，使学生保持在裁剪范围内；虽然轨迹最初来自离策略数据，蒸馏过程却近似保持为在策略。实验显示，MRPD在推理、搜索和SQL等长程任务上效果优于在线强化学习基线及多教师在线策略蒸馏，计算成本也低得多；研究还发现，轨迹顺序比数据量或奖励更关键，专家日志更像一套课程，而非普通数据混合。

papers.title: Unified Law for Visual Tasks (The Four Laws of Computer Vision)
papers.abstract: Abstract A unified framework, World Snapshot Models, is proposed to train and perform nearly all visual tasks by reformulating them as generation tasks, validated across over 1,000 visual tasks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash In this paper, we propose a Unified Law for Visual Tasks, which could be further divided into Four Laws of Computer Vision, with the goal of enabling a single framework or method to uniformly train on and perform nearly all visual tasks. Our starting point is an inspiration and hypothesis: if the world information is encoded into image, which we call World Snapshots, then image processing is world processing, and image generation is World Snapshot generation. Furthermore, if all visual and visualization tasks can be reformulated as generation tasks, then a unified method, World Snapshot Models (WSMs), can perform the vast majority of visual tasks, much as large language models have largely unified natural language processing. This paper validates these laws across more than 1,000 trained and evaluated visual tasks (defined by distinct input-output mappings) and presents a unified training framework for future visual-task research and applications.

ru.title: Все задачи компьютерного зрения — одна задача генерации изображений
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают унифицированную архитектуру World Snapshot Models (WSM), которая решает почти все задачи компьютерного зрения, переформулируя их как задачи генерации изображений. Основная гипотеза: вся информация о мире кодируется в изображение (так называемые World Snapshots), поэтому обработка изображений равносильна обработке мира, а её можно выполнять через генерацию. Аналогично тому, как LLM объединили задачи обработки естественного языка, предлагается единый метод для визуальных задач. Эффективность подхода проверена на более чем 1000 различных визуальных задачах, заданных разными отображениями входа и выхода.

en.title: One Generative Framework for Many Vision Tasks
en.desc: The paper proposes World Snapshot Models (WSMs), a unified framework for training and performing many computer vision tasks. It treats images as snapshots that encode information about the world, so processing images is viewed as processing that information. The central idea is to reformulate visual tasks as image-generation tasks and use one model framework to solve them. The authors report testing this approach on more than 1,000 visual tasks with different input-output mappings.

zh.title: 把视觉任务统一为生成：让一个模型读懂并生成世界快照
zh.desc: 论文提出世界快照模型（WSM），希望用一个统一框架训练和执行大多数视觉任务。它把图像视为包含世界信息的“世界快照”，因此图像处理可以理解为处理世界信息。论文进一步主张，可将视觉任务和可视化任务统一改写为生成任务，由模型生成相应的世界快照结果。研究在超过 1,000 种不同输入输出映射的视觉任务上进行了验证，并提出统一的训练框架。

papers.title: Kezek: Splitting Mono Two-Person Conversations into Per-Speaker Tracks for Full-Duplex Dialogue Data
papers.abstract: Abstract Kezek separates a mono two-speaker conversation into per-speaker tracks while preserving timing and short replies, using a phase-insensitive speaker-fingerprint-guided two-voice activity model followed by a conditioned time-domain separator, and it improves short-reply retention, leakage, channel-swap, and runtime metrics over an open baseline.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Full-duplex spoken dialogue models learn turn-taking, overlaps and backchannels from conversations recorded with one channel per speaker, but most available conversational audio is a single mono mix. We present Kezek, a model that turns a mono recording of exactly two people into one track per person with the original length and timing; overlaps and short replies ("yeah", "mm-hm") stay on the track of the person who said them. Kezek decides who speaks when and who is who once for the whole recording (stage 1: a two-voice activity model guided by a speaker fingerprint trained to be insensitive to phase), and a conditioned time-domain separator only carries out that decision (stage 2), with outputs that always sum to the input. Standard separation metrics miss the failures that matter for dialogue data, so we report short-reply retention, leakage onto the other person's solo, channel swaps and coverage. Against the open pipeline pyannote -> DialogueSidon on the same recordings, Kezek keeps more short replies (0.83 vs. 0.69 on Open Yap test; 0.80 vs. 0.71 over the other's speech on unseen telephone speech from CallHome English), mostly because it returns the whole recording while the external pipeline drops part of it (on the audio both return, reply retention is about the same: 0.859 vs. 0.865 on Open Yap); it also leaks less, swaps channels less often, and runs 4-5 times faster (about 230 hours of audio per GPU-hour). We also report negative results and an ideal-mask ceiling that locate the remaining gap: quiet replies under a louder voice. Code and weights are released under permissive licences.

ru.title: Каждому собеседнику — свою дорожку, даже для коротких «угу»
ru.desc: Статья представляет Kezek — модель, которая разделяет моно-запись диалога двух людей на отдельные дорожки для каждого говорящего, сохраняя исходную длительность и тайминг. Разделение выполняется в два этапа: сначала двухголосовая модель детекции речевой активности (voice activity model) с учётом speaker fingerprint, устойчивого к фазе, определяет, кто и когда говорит, затем time-domain separator по этому условию выделяет дорожки. Авторы вводят метрики, важные для диалоговых данных: сохранение коротких реплик, утечку речи, перестановку каналов и покрытие. По этим метрикам Kezek превосходит открытый конвейер pyannote -> DialogueSidon и работает в 4-5 раз быстрее.

en.title: Keep Every Voice—and Every Reply—in Its Place
en.desc: Kezek separates a mono recording of two speakers into two tracks while keeping the original timing and overlapping speech. First, a phase-insensitive speaker fingerprint guides a model that estimates who is speaking when; then a conditioned time-domain separator creates the tracks, which always sum to the input. Compared with an open baseline, Kezek retains more short replies overall, reduces speaker leakage and channel swaps, and runs four to five times faster, though some gains come from covering more of the recording. Quiet replies masked by a louder voice remain a key challenge.

zh.title: 先认人、再分轨，让对话中的每声回应都不掉线
zh.desc: Kezek 将只有一个声道、包含两个人的对话录音，分离成两条与原录音等长且时间对齐的说话人音轨。它先用对相位不敏感的说话人指纹引导双人语音活动检测，确定每个人何时说话，再用条件式时域分离器执行分离，并确保两条输出相加后等于输入。与公开基线相比，Kezek 能保留更多简短回应、减少串音和说话人声道互换，运行速度也快约 4 至 5 倍；部分提升来自它会保留完整录音。它仍难以分离被较大声语音盖住的轻声回应，论文也报告了这一局限及理想掩码性能上限。

papers.title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
papers.abstract: Abstract BiCAT shares a motion representation across arms and conditions each arm's tokens on its partner via symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder, enabling parallel arm token prediction and improving bimanual manipulation success.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. We propose Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization (BiCAT), which shares one motion representation across arms while conditioning each arm's tokens on its partner through symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder. The policy then predicts all tokens of each arm in parallel, generating the left arm first and the right arm conditioned on it. Across ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and six real-world tasks on three embodiments, BiCAT achieves the highest success among the compared tokenizers. In simulation, it improves mean success by 17.6 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines, with the largest gains on tasks that require close coordination between the arms, while requiring only 40.5 ms per action chunk. These results suggest that the action tokenizer is a natural place to model bimanual coordination.

ru.title: Координация рук начинается с токенизации действий
ru.desc: В статье предлагается BiCAT — метод токенизации действий для двуручной манипуляции в autoregressive VLA моделях. Он использует общее представление движений для обеих рук и симметричное cross-arm attention, чтобы токены каждой руки учитывали партнёрскую. Модель предсказывает токены обеих рук параллельно, сначала левой, затем правой с учётом левой. На задачах RoboTwin 2.0 и реальных роботах BiCAT превосходит существующие токенизаторы, особенно там, где нужна тесная координация рук.

en.title: Share the motion, coordinate the arms
en.desc: BiCAT is an action tokenizer for vision-language-action models that control two robot arms. It uses a shared motion representation for both arms and symmetric cross-arm attention so each arm’s tokens can account for its partner’s movements. The policy predicts the left arm’s tokens first, then predicts the right arm’s tokens conditioned on the left, with all tokens for each arm generated in parallel. Across simulation and real-world tasks, BiCAT achieved the highest success among the tested tokenizers, with especially large gains on tasks requiring close coordination.

zh.title: 让双臂共享动作表示，在协调中协同出手
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出双臂协调动作分词器 BiCAT，让左右手臂共享同一种动作表示，并通过对称跨臂注意力和联合解码器建模两臂之间的依赖关系。策略先预测左臂的动作 token，再以左臂动作为条件预测右臂的 token；每只手臂内部的 token 可以并行预测。BiCAT 在 RoboTwin 2.0 的十项任务和三种机器人平台上的六项真实任务中，取得了所有对比方法中最高的成功率；在仿真中，它比八种基线中表现最好的方法平均高出 17.6 个百分点。结果表明，将双臂协调直接融入动作分词器，有助于提升需要紧密配合的操作表现，而且每个动作片段仅需 40.5 毫秒生成。

papers.title: Movie2Game-Bench: Holistic Evaluation of Film-to-Game Adaptation Beyond Playability
papers.abstract: Abstract  Adapting a film into a game requires selecting source elements and translating them into player actions, rules, and feedback. We introduce Movie2Game-Bench (M2G-bench), a benchmark for evaluating film-to-game adaptation beyond playability. M2G-bench combines general evaluation, movie-specific evaluation, and playtesting by three GUI model players. The protocol connects source content to gameplay steps and implementation evidence, capturing both content preservation and interactive realization. The benchmark comprises 22 films and 658 source-specific reference items. Evaluating 14 models on the same films with their selected primary harnesses reveals complementary strengths in game quality, adaptation, and player experience. A shared weakness concerns playable sequences: this category has the lowest content-presence mean in all 14 models, averaging 37.9 out of 100 compared with 54.8 for iconic elements. Among judgments of retained emotionaldevelopment content, narrative choices account for 60.0% and scenario operation for 7.2%. These findings identify two linked priorities for film-to-game adaptation: preserving source situations that can support gameplay and connecting retained content to player actions and consequences.

ru.title: От кадра к геймплею: как сохранить душу фильма в игре
ru.desc: В статье предлагается M2G-bench — бенчмарк для оценки адаптации фильмов в игры, который выходит за рамки простой играбельности. Он объединяет общую оценку, оценку, специфичную для конкретных фильмов, и плейтестинг, проводимый тремя GUI-моделями в роли игроков. Бенчмарк включает 22 фильма и 658 референсных элементов, а 14 моделей показывают разные сильные стороны в качестве игры, адаптации и игровом опыте. Общая слабость всех моделей — сохранение игровых последовательностей, которые переносятся хуже всего, тогда как ключевые эмоционально-сюжетные элементы чаще сохраняются через нарративные решения.

en.title: Turn Film Moments into Meaningful Play
en.desc: The paper introduces M2G-bench, a benchmark for evaluating how well games adapt films, including both game quality and fidelity to the source. It assesses general qualities, film-specific content, and player experience through tests with three GUI-based model players. Across 14 models and 22 films, the benchmark finds that playable sequences are often missing, while iconic elements are preserved more successfully. The results suggest that adaptations should preserve film situations suited to gameplay and connect story content to player actions and consequences.

zh.title: 让电影情境成为玩法，让玩家行动承载故事
zh.desc: 本文提出电影改编游戏评测基准 M2G-bench，用来衡量改编是否保留电影内容并将其转化为可玩的互动体验，而不只是检查游戏能否运行。该基准结合通用评估、电影特定评估和三个 GUI 模型玩家的试玩，并将电影原作内容与游戏步骤及实现证据对应起来。研究评测了 14 个模型，发现它们在游戏质量、改编效果和玩家体验方面各有优势，但对可玩情节的保留普遍较弱，其平均得分为 37.9，低于标志性元素的 54.8。研究指出，电影改编游戏应优先保留能够支持玩法的原作情境，并将保留的内容与玩家行动及其后果紧密连接。

papers.title: Out of Sight, Still in Mind: Token Compression for Omni-LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract ReMo, a training-free method, reduces inference input token cost for omni-modal large language models by compressing redundant visual tokens through cross-modal alignment and replacing object-level visual tokens with compact text descriptions, achieving comparable accuracy on audio-visual tasks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash The goal of this paper is to reduce the input token cost of Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) at inference time. Omni-LLMs reason jointly over audio, video and text, but the cost of the three streams is highly unbalanced: visual tokens account for the vast majority of the input, and are highly redundant. In this paper, we propose ReMo, a training-free framework that compresses visual tokens by redistributing their information across modalities: a visual token is kept only if its information appears nowhere else. ReMo achieves this in two ways: (i) it aligns audio and video in a shared space via closed-form calibration, and removes visual tokens already explained by the audio or by other visual tokens; and (ii) it replaces object-level visual tokens, identified by a lightweight object detector, with compact text proxies, short descriptions of each object and its location, conveying the same content in far fewer tokens. On Qwen2.5-Omni at two model scales, ReMo removes 54% of the input tokens with comparable accuracy. It performs comparably to the full-token model, reaching 101.2% and 101.4% of its average accuracy over five audio-visual benchmarks.

ru.title: Меньше токенов, та же точность: сжимаем видео за счёт перераспределения информации между модальностями
ru.desc: Статья представляет ReMo — метод без дообучения (training-free), который сокращает число входных токенов для Omni-LLM при инференсе. Он выравнивает аудио и видео в общем пространстве через closed-form калибровку и удаляет визуальные токены, информация которых уже объясняется аудио или другими визуальными токенами. Объектные визуальные токены, найденные лёгким детектором объектов, заменяются компактными текстовыми описаниями объектов и их расположения. На Qwen2.5-Omni ReMo убирает 54% входных токенов, сохраняя точность на уровне полной модели (101.2% и 101.4% средней точности на пяти audio-visual бенчмарках).

en.title: Keep the meaning, cut the visual tokens
en.desc: ReMo is a training-free method that reduces the number of input tokens used by omni-modal large language models during inference. It compresses redundant visual information by aligning audio and video representations, then removing visual tokens already represented by audio or other visual tokens. It also replaces detected objects with short text descriptions of the objects and their locations. On five audio-visual benchmarks, ReMo removes 54% of input tokens while maintaining accuracy comparable to the full-token model.

zh.title: 删去冗余视觉信息，用更少 token 保持视听理解能力
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了 ReMo，一种无需训练、用于降低全模态大语言模型推理输入成本的方法。它利用跨模态对齐识别视频中已由音频或其他视觉内容表达的信息，并删除冗余视觉 token。对于物体层级的视觉 token，ReMo 使用轻量级检测器识别物体，再以包含物体及其位置的简短文本描述替代。实验显示，ReMo 可减少 54% 的输入 token，同时在五项视听基准测试上保持与完整输入相近的准确率。

papers.title: Let Samples Sing in Chorus: Mitigating Spurious Correlations via Cross-view Consensus
papers.abstract: Abstract A multi-view debiasing method aggregates within-class partitions across diverse representation spaces to reduce reliance on spurious correlations and improve worst-group accuracy without bias supervision.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Deep models often rely on spurious correlations that fail on underrepresented groups. Existing methods either correct human-specified bias attributes or infer unknown biases from the learned representation space. However, annotated attributes may differ from the shortcuts actually used by a model, while a single representation provides incomplete and potentially noisy evidence. Our key insight is that a bias obscured in one feature space may be clearer in another. In this work, we propose CHORD (Cross-view Harmonic Outlier Reversal for Debiasing), a multi-view framework that allows samples to "sing in chorus" across diverse representation spaces to achieve robust cross-view consensus. CHORD aggregates aggregates within-class partitions in each view, which is a proxy for specifying candidate biases, to debias the target representation and classifier without bias supervision. Experiments on seven benchmarks across vision, language, speech, and medical imaging show consistent improvements in worst-group accuracy. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/davelee-uestc/chord_debiasing_public .
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Когда признаки поют в унисон, смещения становятся видны
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод CHORD для устранения смещений (debiasing) в глубоких моделях, которые полагаются на ложные корреляции и плохо работают на недопредставленных группах. Вместо использования размеченных атрибутов смещения метод анализирует несколько пространств признаков (multi-view) и выделяет внутриклассовые разбиения, которые служат кандидатами на скрытые bias. Затем эти разбиения агрегируются, чтобы скорректировать целевое представление и классификатор без надзора за смещениями. Эксперименты на семи бенчмарках в задачах компьютерного зрения, NLP, распознавания речи и медицинской визуализации показывают стабильный рост worst-group accuracy.

en.title: Let Multiple Views Expose the Shortcuts
en.desc: CHORD reduces a model’s reliance on spurious correlations without requiring labels that identify the bias. It finds groups of similar examples within each class across several representation spaces, using these partitions as clues to possible biases. By combining clues from multiple views, it can reveal patterns that may be unclear in any one representation and use them to debias the target representation and classifier. Tests across seven benchmarks in vision, language, speech, and medical imaging show improved worst-group accuracy.

zh.title: 让多视图线索合唱，减少模型对虚假相关的依赖
zh.desc: 深度模型可能会依赖与标签相关、但对少数群体并不可靠的虚假相关，从而降低最差群体准确率。CHORD 是一种无需偏差标注的多视图去偏框架，它利用多个不同表示空间中的信息来发现潜在偏差。具体来说，该方法汇总各视图内同类别样本的划分结果，形成跨视图共识，并用它来调整目标表示和分类器。实验覆盖视觉、语言、语音和医学影像等七个基准，结果显示该方法能持续提升最差群体准确率。

papers.title: IDEA: Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit for Inference-Time Backdoor Detection in GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract A step-level inference-time audit detects visual-trigger backdoors in open-weight GUI agents by comparing instruction- and region-induced shifts in decision state against clean-step conformal baselines, localizing triggers with controlled false positives.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Organizations increasingly deploy downloaded open-weight GUI agents. A backdoored agent passes acceptance tests on clean data and misbehaves only when a visual trigger appears on screen, turning an unvetted checkpoint into a supply-chain risk. However, existing sample-level detectors target image classifiers and CLIP-style encoders, leaving step-level backdoor detection for GUI agents unaddressed. On clean steps, the instruction drives the action; when an unreferenced screen region hijacks the step, the instruction loses control over the decision state or that region dictates it instead. We term this signature intent--evidence dominance inversion and propose IDEA (Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit) to detect backdoor activation at inference time for each step without trigger knowledge or attack data. Specifically, Intent Counterfactual Probing (ICP) measures how far redirected instructions move the decision state, and Region Causal Audit (RCA) quantifies how far ablating a candidate region moves it. A gated conformal score compares both displacements against clean steps at the same distance from the clean manifold, providing a finite-sample false-positive guarantee. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B across five attack families show that IDEA consistently detects backdoor activation under a controlled false-positive rate and outperforms state-of-the-art detection methods, while localizing the trigger region for every alarm and adding only modest inference overhead.

ru.title: Инструкция должна решать, а не экранный триггер: аудит агентов на лету
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод IDEA для обнаружения backdoor-атак в открытых GUI-агентах на базе мультимодальных LLM во время инференса, без знания триггера и данных атаки. Ключевая идея: при срабатывании визуального триггера инструкция теряет контроль над решением, а доминирование переходит к нерелевантной области экрана (intent-evidence dominance inversion). Методы ICP и RCA измеряют смещение decision state при переформулировке инструкции и при аблации региона, а gated conformal score сравнивает эти смещения с чистыми шагами, давая гарантию контроля false-positive. Эксперименты на Qwen2.5-VL-3B по пяти семействам атак показывают, что IDEA надежно обнаруживает атаки, локализует триггерный регион и добавляет лишь умеренные накладные расходы.

en.title: Catch the Visual Trigger Before the Agent Acts
en.desc: IDEA detects visual-trigger backdoors in open-weight GUI agents while they run, without needing examples of attacks or knowing the trigger in advance. It checks whether changing the instruction or removing a screen region shifts the agent’s decision state, revealing when an unrelated region overrides the instruction. A conformal score compares these shifts with clean-step baselines to control false positives. Tests on five attack types show that IDEA detects backdoor activation, identifies the trigger region, and adds modest inference overhead.

zh.title: 审计指令与视觉证据的主导权，及时发现并定位 GUI 后门
zh.desc: 这篇论文研究如何在推理时发现 GUI 智能体中的视觉后门：恶意图像触发器会让智能体偏离用户指令。作者提出 IDEA 方法，逐步检查决策状态是否仍由指令主导，还是被屏幕上未被指令提及的区域控制。它通过改变指令和遮挡候选区域来测量决策状态的变化，并用干净步骤建立的保形基线判断异常，同时定位可能的触发区域。实验表明，IDEA 在控制误报率的同时能检测多种后门攻击，且推理开销较小。

papers.title: Choosing Quantized Code LLMs by File Size and Energy per Solved Task
papers.abstract: Abstract  A developer running a code assistant on a laptop downloads one model file, and local inference moves the energy of every request onto that machine. A common rule says a larger model at lower precision tends to beat a smaller one at higher precision. We ran 24 GGUF files of Qwen2.5-Coder at four sizes on a fanless MacBook Air M2 and priced each in energy per solved task on 542 EvalPlus tasks. The result is a selection guide indexed by Ollama's listed file size, with an evidence label on each pick. At 1 and 2 GB it picks the q4_K_M files of the 1.5B and 3B models, both on the correctness and energy frontier under every accounting. At 3 GB as listed, the larger-model rule picks 7B-q2_K, the only measured 7B file that fits, and there it does not pay. That file brings no significant gain in solves over the 2 GB pick, 3B-q4_K_M, and the 90% CI limits any 3B-q4_K_M deficit to 2.4 points. Yet 7B-q2_K needs 2.03 times the energy per solved task on CPU, GPU and memory rails, or 1.66 to 1.81 times on whole-system power. On HumanEval+, five alternating session pairs give a ratio of 1.925 against 1.956 in the main grid. At 8 GB, 7B-q6_K buys a significant gain over the 2 GB pick at a higher energy price. From 1.5B up, q4_K_M trails the highest precision measured at its size by less than 3 points (90% CI). We release per-task results, power logs and the analysis script.

ru.title: Большая модель не всегда выгоднее: считаем энергию на каждую решённую задачу
ru.desc: Авторы сравнивают 24 GGUF-варианта модели Qwen2.5-Coder разных размеров и уровней квантования на ноутбуке MacBook Air M2 без вентилятора и оценивают энергию на каждую решённую задачу на 542 задачах EvalPlus. Они показывают, что правило «чем больше модель при меньшей точности, тем лучше» не всегда работает: при размере 3 ГБ 7B-q2_K почти не даёт прироста решений по сравнению с 3B-q4_K_M, но тратит примерно в два раза больше энергии. Для размеров 1 и 2 ГБ лучшими оказываются q4_K_M-варианты моделей 1.5B и 3B, а при 8 ГБ 7B-q6_K даёт значимый прирост, но за более высокую цену в энергии. Результаты оформлены в виде руководства по выбору модели с оценкой статистической достоверности каждого решения, а данные, логи мощности и скрипт анализа опубликованы в открытом доступе.

en.title: Bigger Models Don’t Always Pay Off in Energy
en.desc: This study measures the energy and coding-task accuracy of 24 quantized GGUF versions of Qwen2.5-Coder on a fanless MacBook Air M2. It compares models by listed file size, using 542 EvalPlus tasks and measuring energy per solved task. The 7B model at 2-bit precision, the only measured 7B file that fits in 3 GB, does not significantly improve solves over the 3B model at q4_K_M, but uses substantially more energy per solved task. At 8 GB, the 7B q6_K model delivers a significant accuracy gain at a higher energy cost; the authors also release task results, power logs, and analysis code.

zh.title: 选模型看每题能耗：更大未必更省、更准
zh.desc: 本文在无风扇的 M2 MacBook Air 上测试了 24 个 Qwen2.5-Coder GGUF 模型文件，并用 542 个 EvalPlus 任务评估解题正确率与每道已解决任务的能耗。结果显示，1 GB 和 2 GB 档位中，1.5B 与 3B 模型的 q4_K_M 量化版本都处于正确率和能耗的帕累托前沿。3 GB 档位的 7B-q2_K 虽然符合“大模型低精度可能更强”的常见判断，却没有比 2 GB 档位的 3B-q4_K_M 显著多解题，能耗反而高出约 1.66 至 2.03 倍。到 8 GB 档位，7B-q6_K 才以更高能耗换来显著的正确率提升；此外，q4_K_M 与同尺寸最高精度版本的正确率差距通常不到 3 个百分点。

papers.title: AVTR: Adaptive Multimodal Reasoning with Visual Imagination
papers.abstract: Abstract Adaptive Visual-Textual Reasoning combines generative visual reflection with textual reasoning and learns to route between them per input, improving multimodal task accuracy while reducing inference latency.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Vision-Language Models increasingly rely on textual reasoning to solve advanced multimodal tasks. Despite its effectiveness, this paradigm faces two fundamental limitations. First, relying on textual reasoning alone can limit perceptual ability in vision-centric questions, where accurate answers depend on interpreting task-relevant visual evidence. Second, applying textual reasoning uniformly across inputs overlooks question-dependent variation in both reasoning modality and depth, often producing verbose and unnecessary traces when little logical inference is required. To this end, we propose Adaptive Visual-Textual Reasoning (AVTR), which introduces visual imagination as a complementary reasoning modality to textual thinking, enabling the model to revisit its visual observations and distill the salient evidence through generative visual reflection. Furthermore, we formulate reasoning-modality selection as a learned routing problem, allowing a single policy to adaptively harness the complementary strengths of visual reflection and textual reasoning in response to the perceptual and inferential demands of the input. Across 16 benchmarks, AVTR improves the average score by 4.5 points over Qwen3.5 baseline, while reducing inference latency by 33\%. It also scales effectively into a smaller size backbone, outperforming the evaluated 2B-scale baselines.
affiliations: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

ru.title: Видеть и думать: модель сама выбирает, как рассуждать
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают Adaptive Visual-Textual Reasoning (AVTR) — подход для Vision-Language Models, который дополняет текстовые рассуждения визуальным воображением. Модель может возвращаться к визуальным наблюдениям и выделять ключевые признаки через generative visual reflection. Выбор модальности рассуждений формулируется как задача learned routing, где единая policy адаптивно решает, использовать ли визуальную рефлексию или текстовый reasoning. На 16 бенчмарках AVTR улучшает средний балл на 4.5 пункта относительно baseline Qwen3.5 и сокращает inference latency на 33%.

en.title: Choose the Right Way to Reason: See, Think, or Both
en.desc: Adaptive Visual-Textual Reasoning (AVTR) combines visual reflection with textual reasoning for vision-language models. Visual reflection revisits image observations and highlights evidence relevant to the question. A learned routing policy chooses which reasoning mode to use based on each input’s perceptual and inference needs. Across 16 benchmarks, AVTR improves average performance by 4.5 points over the Qwen3.5 baseline while reducing inference latency by 33%.

zh.title: 按需切换视觉与文本推理，让多模态思考更准更快
zh.desc: 本文提出自适应视觉-文本推理（AVTR），将生成式视觉反思作为文本推理的补充。模型通过重新审视图像并提炼关键信息，提升对视觉证据的理解能力。AVTR将推理方式选择建模为学习式路由，根据输入需求在视觉反思与文本推理之间动态切换。实验显示，该方法在16项基准测试中平均提升4.5分、推理延迟降低33%，并在小型模型上也表现出竞争力。

papers.title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
papers.abstract: Abstract A prototype-guided progressive obfuscation method preserves relative item relations while perturbing high-influence semantic embeddings to defend against inversion attacks in LLM-enhanced recommender systems.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks. Existing input-side defenses rely on trusted collection or local token perturbation, often disrupting the inter-item semantic topology needed for recommendation. To address it, we introduce relational fidelity as the key objective, requiring semantic shift for privacy while preserving relative item relations for utility. Based on this principle, we propose prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO), which learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and propagates them through a static semantic graph. PGPO is optimized with GRPO using individual dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraint rewards. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong inversion defense with near-upper-bound recommendation performance. The code is available at https://github.com/Shengxiang-Lin/PGPO.

ru.title: Защитить приватность, сохранив связи между товарами
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод PGPO для защиты LLM-enhanced рекомендательных систем от атак инверсии, которые могут восстановить чувствительные текстовые атрибуты из семантических эмбеддингов товаров. Авторы вводят принцип relational fidelity: эмбеддинги должны смещаться достаточно для приватности, но сохранять относительные отношения между товарами для качества рекомендаций. Метод выявляет high-influence prototype words, обучает topology-aware obfuscation anchors и распространяет их по статическому семантическому графу. Оптимизация выполняется с помощью GRPO с наградами за индивидуальное различие, структурную согласованность и семантические ограничения, и эксперименты показывают сильную защиту при почти максимальной качественности рекомендаций.

en.title: Hide sensitive meaning, preserve useful item relations
en.desc: The paper presents prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO) to protect semantic embeddings in LLM-enhanced recommender systems from inversion attacks. It perturbs influential prototype words to hide sensitive information while preserving relative item relations, which are important for recommendation. PGPO learns obfuscation anchors and propagates them through a static semantic graph, using GRPO with rewards for dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraints. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong defense against inversion while retaining recommendation performance close to the upper bound.

zh.title: 扰动语义嵌入，守住隐私与推荐关系
zh.desc: 面向大语言模型增强的推荐系统，物品语义嵌入可能在反演攻击中泄露敏感文本属性。现有防护方法常破坏物品之间的语义关系，进而影响推荐效果。本文提出原型引导的渐进式混淆方法（PGPO），扰动高影响力原型词的语义嵌入，并借助静态语义图传播扰动，以保护隐私并保留物品间的相对关系。该方法通过GRPO优化个体差异、结构一致性和语义约束奖励，在两个基准数据集上有效抵御反演攻击，同时保持接近上限的推荐性能。

papers.title: A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
papers.abstract: Abstract A foundation model fine-tuned from a large language model measures and predicts human behaviour and aligns simulated population responses with human statistics, improving accuracy over frontier LLMs.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron's psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2--94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.

ru.title: Chiron: единый инструмент для измерения и предсказания человеческого поведения
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Chiron, фундаментальную модель (foundation model), полученную дообучением большой языковой модели (LLM) на данных о поведении людей. Модель совместно обучается представлять психологические конструкты, предсказывать индивидуальное поведение и выравнивать распределения ответов симулированной популяции с человеческой статистикой. Обучение и оценка проведены на 36 поведенческих доменах, 78 социальных экспериментах и более чем 288 тысячах записей людей. Chiron точнее совпадает с самоотчётами людей, предсказывает поведение лучше передовых LLM (до 28,4% относительного улучшения) и точнее воспроизводит эффекты социальных экспериментов.

en.title: A foundation model that measures people and predicts human behaviour more accurately
en.desc: Chiron is a foundation model fine-tuned from a large language model to measure psychological traits, predict individual behaviour, and simulate populations. It is trained on behavioural data from 36 domains and 78 social science experiments, including human self-reports and decisions. Compared with frontier language models, Chiron predicts individual behaviour more accurately and produces psychological measurements with fewer biases. In experiment simulations, it also estimates the direction and size of human effects more accurately, with substantially lower error.

zh.title: 让 AI 不只生成像人的回答，更准确地测量和预测人类行为
zh.desc: 本文提出了 Chiron，一个通过大语言模型微调得到的基础模型，用于测量和预测人类行为。它在训练中共同学习心理构念测量、个体行为预测，并让模拟人群的回答分布与真实人类统计数据对齐。实验显示，Chiron 的心理测量结果更接近人类自我报告，个体行为预测也优于前沿大语言模型，最高相对提升 28.4%。在模拟社会科学实验时，它对实验效应方向和大小的估计误差降低了 82.2% 至 94.3%。

papers.title: Recurrent Domain Incremental Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Abstract PACT adapts a pretrained time-series foundation model to new operating conditions by partitioning its frozen embedding space into local charts and learning gated residual transports that preserve previously learned conditions, achieving high macro-F1 with limited labeled calibration data and no condition identity at test time.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide strong representations for downstream classification tasks. Yet adapting a TSFM under changing operating conditions remains challenging. A model must improve on each newly observed condition without sacrificing conditions it has already learned, often from only a small labeled calibration set and without knowing the operating condition at inference time. We find that this difficulty has an important geometric structure. Under an operating-condition shift, the embedding space of a TSFM does not move uniformly: some local regions change substantially, while others remain nearly unchanged. Consequently, a global adaptation can unnecessarily move embeddings that were already correctly classified. To address this, we propose the novel PACT (Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport). PACT partitions the frozen source embedding space into local charts and learns lightweight residual transports for the regions affected by each new condition. An explicit identity path is always retained, and a learned gate softly selects among the identity and accumulated transports for each input. The pretrained TSFM encoder, classifier head, and previously learned transports remain fixed. With only 5% labeled calibration data per arriving condition and no condition identity at test time, PACT maintains an average macro-F1 above 0.95 across a four-condition bearing-fault stream. Under homogeneous tasks and label spaces, similar retention-adaptation behavior is observed across public benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Sachithx/PACT.

ru.title: Адаптируем только то, что изменилось: кусочная трансформация эмбеддингов без забывания
ru.desc: Статья предлагает метод PACT для адаптации предобученной модели временных рядов (TSFM) к новым условиям эксплуатации без потери уже выученных знаний. Замороженное пространство эмбеддингов разбивается на локальные чарты, и для каждого нового условия обучаются лёгкие остаточные трансформации, а обучаемый gate мягко выбирает между identity-путём и накопленными трансформациями. Метод требует всего 5% размеченных калибровочных данных на каждое условие и не нуждается в знании условия на этапе инференса. На потоке из четырёх условий для диагностики подшипников macro-F1 держится выше 0.95, а схожее поведение наблюдается и на публичных бенчмарках.

en.title: Adapt locally, remember what already works
en.desc: PACT adapts a pretrained time-series foundation model to new operating conditions while keeping its encoder and classifier fixed. It divides the model’s embedding space into local regions, called charts, and learns small residual transports only for regions affected by a new condition. A learned gate chooses between the unchanged representation and the available transports, helping preserve performance on conditions learned earlier. Experiments show strong macro-F1 with only 5% labeled calibration data per condition, even when the condition is unknown at test time.

zh.title: 局部传输适应新条件，保留旧知识
zh.desc: 预训练时间序列基础模型遇到新的运行条件时，需要适应变化，同时避免损害对旧条件的识别能力。论文发现，条件变化只会显著影响嵌入空间的部分局部区域，因此对整个空间进行统一调整可能会破坏原有的正确分类。为此，PACT 将冻结的嵌入空间划分为局部图表，并为受影响区域学习轻量级残差传输，同时用门控机制在原始表示和已学传输之间进行选择。实验表明，每种新条件仅使用 5% 的标注校准数据、且测试时无需知道条件身份，PACT 在四种轴承故障条件上的平均宏 F1 仍超过 0.95。
